# Accept Visa, Mastercard and PayPal payments from international…

> For buyers outside Zimbabwe, WavePay offers Visa and Mastercard through the hosted paynow checkout and PayPal through provider paypal, on the same checkout call — so…

PAYMENT RAIL

# Accept Visa, Mastercard and PayPal payments from international buyers

For buyers outside Zimbabwe, WavePay offers Visa and Mastercard through the hosted paynow checkout and PayPal through provider paypal, on the same checkout call — so one integration serves local and international customers.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## How it works

1. **Same registration.** The merchant key you already have works for every rail.
2. **Pick the provider.** provider "paypal" for PayPal (its checkout also takes Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover and JCB); "paynow" for the hosted checkout that carries Visa and Mastercard alongside the Zimbabwean rails.
3. **Settle in one ledger.** Local and international payments appear in the same ledger, so reconciliation is one feed.

```
curl -sX POST https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"your-product","planId":"pro","provider":"paypal","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

## Good to know

- A seller in Harare, Nairobi, Lagos or Lisbon uses the same API; the rails offered depend on what the deployment enabled.
- PayPal and PayNow fees are their own.

## Questions

## Can WavePay take international cards?

Yes — Visa and Mastercard are taken through the hosted paynow checkout and through PayPal, which also takes American Express, Discover and JCB.

## Do I need a second integration for PayPal?

No. It is the same POST /v2/checkouts call with provider "paypal".

PAYMENT RAIL

# Accept EcoCash payments in your software

To accept EcoCash, register a WavePay merchant, then create a checkout with provider paynow for a hosted page or paynow-mobile with the buyer's phone number to push the EcoCash prompt straight to their handset.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## How it works

1. **Register once.** POST https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/register with a name and ownerEmail. The live key is shown once.
2. **Create the checkout.** Use provider paynow for a hosted checkout URL, or paynow-mobile plus phone for an express wallet push.
3. **Confirm settlement.** Poll GET /v2/checkouts/<reference>/status or receive a signed webhook; a licence key is emailed automatically if licensing is on.

```
curl -sX POST https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"your-product","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow-mobile","email":"buyer@example.com","phone":"+2637XXXXXXXX"}'
```

## Good to know

- Express push (paynow-mobile) covers EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks and O'mari; the buyer approves on their handset with their PIN, and the wallet a deployment pushes to is part of its configuration.
- Which rails a deployment enables is reported by GET /v2/providers — check it before showing EcoCash in your UI.
- Provider fees are the provider's own; WavePay takes no percentage of your sales.

## Questions

## Do I need a separate EcoCash merchant integration?

No. WavePay's checkout reaches EcoCash through the same POST /v2/checkouts call you use for every other rail.

## Can I charge an EcoCash user without sending them to a web page?

Yes. Provider paynow-mobile with the buyer's phone number pushes the wallet prompt to the handset.

## Can an agent set EcoCash payments up?

Yes. skill.md and the MCP tool wavepay_checkout cover the full flow with no browser.

# Accept OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch…

> WavePay reaches OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through the same checkout call as EcoCash — one integration, with GET /v2/providers reporting which…

PAYMENT RAIL

# Accept OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch payments

WavePay reaches OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through the same checkout call as EcoCash — one integration, with GET /v2/providers reporting which are live on your deployment. OneMoney, InnBucks and O'mari also support wallet push.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## How it works

1. **Ask what is live.** GET /v2/providers returns the rails the deployment has enabled — build your payment picker from it, not from a hard-coded list.
2. **Create the checkout.** POST /v2/checkouts with provider paynow (hosted, all rails) or paynow-mobile (wallet push, EcoCash/OneMoney/InnBucks/O'mari only).
3. **Reconcile.** Every settlement lands in the payments ledger; drain it with POST /v2/internal/payments using since/limit cursors.

```
curl -sX POST https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"your-product","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

| Rail | Type | How a buyer pays |
| --- | --- | --- |
| EcoCash | Mobile wallet | Hosted checkout, or wallet push with paynow-mobile |
| OneMoney | Mobile wallet | Hosted checkout, or wallet push with paynow-mobile |
| InnBucks | Mobile wallet | Hosted checkout, or wallet push with paynow-mobile |
| Telecash | Mobile wallet | Hosted checkout |
| O'mari | Mobile wallet | Hosted checkout, or wallet push with paynow-mobile |
| ZimSwitch | Local debit-card network | Hosted checkout |

## Good to know

- One integration covers every rail a deployment enables.
- Idempotency-Key makes a retried request return the same checkout instead of a second one.

## Questions

## Which Zimbabwean payment methods does WavePay support?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch.

## How do I know which ones are enabled for me?

GET /v2/providers lists the live rails for the deployment you are calling.

LEGAL

# Accessibility statement

WavePay aims for WCAG 2.2 level AA on every page: keyboard operation, visible focus, contrast in light and dark themes, reduced motion, right-to-left languages, and how to report a barrier.

Updated 2026-10-31 · TeraTech Solutions (Private) Limited

## Our commitment

We build this site to WCAG 2.2 level AA and check every page with an automated conformance test as well as by hand.

## What we do

- Semantic landmarks, one heading hierarchy per page, a skip link, and descriptive link text.
- Everything works with a keyboard, with visible focus and no focus traps; the search and menus close with Escape.
- Text contrast of at least 4.5:1 in light, dark and system themes; the theme is your choice and is remembered.
- Text can be resized and the layout reflows to a 320px window; touch targets are at least 44px on phones.
- Motion respects `prefers-reduced-motion`; images have text alternatives.
- Fifteen languages, including right-to-left Arabic, each with its own page and a language chooser that names each language in its own script.

## Known limits

- Translations other than English are machine-assisted drafts and may read awkwardly; native review is under way.
- Some payment pages belong to providers (Paynow, PayPal, 2Checkout); their accessibility is theirs to maintain.
- Code examples are text in scrollable blocks that can be copied with the Copy button.

## Tell us about a barrier

Write to [support@t3ratech.co.zw](mailto:support@t3ratech.co.zw) with the page and what went wrong. We aim to reply within five working days and to fix real barriers quickly.

> How WavePay uses AI and automation: no automated decisions about people's payments, where AI drafts text or images, human review, and how to ask about or dispute an…

LEGAL

# EU AI Act and automated decisions

How WavePay uses AI and automation: no automated decisions about people's payments, where AI drafts text or images, human review, and how to ask about or dispute an automated output.

Updated 2026-10-31 · TeraTech Solutions (Private) Limited

## The short version

WavePay is payment infrastructure. It does not use AI to approve, decline, score or profile buyers or merchants. A payment settles because the provider confirms the exact amount, never because a model decided it.

## Where automation exists

- **Rules, not models:** settlement checks, usage metering, rate limits and the crypto quote are deterministic code you can read about in the [API reference](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs/index.html).
- **AI-drafted support replies:** where we use AI to draft an answer to a support email, a person reviews it before it is sent to you.
- **AI-generated images:** illustrations on this site may be AI-generated; they illustrate and do not depict real customers or results.
- **Agent access:** WavePay offers MCP tools so that AI agents you run can use the API with your keys. Those agents are yours; you remain responsible for what they do.

## Classification

On our reading WavePay is not a high-risk AI system under the EU AI Act: it makes no decisions in the high-risk areas of the Act (such as creditworthiness scoring of individuals). If that changes, we will say so here before it ships.

## Your rights

If you think an automated output affected you, write to [support@t3ratech.co.zw](mailto:support@t3ratech.co.zw). A person will look at it, explain what happened and correct it where it was wrong.

# Payment infrastructure for AI agents: MCP payment tools and a…

> WavePay is payment infrastructure for AI agents: skill.md is the whole onboarding, POST /mcp exposes registration, providers, pricing, checkout and status as MCP…

USE CASE

# Payment infrastructure for AI agents: MCP payment tools and a one-file onboarding

WavePay is payment infrastructure for AI agents: skill.md is the whole onboarding, POST /mcp exposes registration, providers, pricing, checkout and status as MCP tools, and an agent can register, check out and reconcile with no browser, OAuth flow or email round-trip.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## The flow

1. MCP payment tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing, wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_catalog at POST /mcp.
2. Machine-readable: /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /skill.md, /openapi.json, /pricing.json and /.well-known/ai-catalog.json.
3. No humans in the loop: registration returns a live key and a test key in one call; the test key runs the whole flow with fake money.
4. Agents can pay too: crypto rails (GET /v2/crypto/rails) need no account, only a wallet.

## Questions

## Can an agent register by itself?

Yes. POST /v2/register with a name and an email returns the keys in one response.

## Where is the machine-readable price list?

/pricing.json, also served live at GET /v2/price-list.

## Keep going

- [How to charge for a browser extension](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/payments-for-browser-extensions.html)
- [How to take payments in a game](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/payments-for-games.html)
- [Accept EcoCash payments in your software](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/accept-ecocash-payments.html)

## الدفع هو الجزء السهل. وWavePay هو كل ما عداه.

### دفع مُستضاف وطلب على المحفظة

أرسل المشترين إلى صفحة مُستضافة، أو أرسل طلب EcoCash مباشرة إلى هواتفهم.

### تراخيص مدمجة

استحقاقات موقّعة ومفاتيح ترخيص بالبريد وتفعيل للأجهزة واستعادة. يتحقق تطبيقك دون اتصال.

### الاشتراكات والتقسيط

خطط متكررة، واشترِ الآن وادفع لاحقًا بالبطاقة، ومهلة تأخير واضحة قبل انتهاء الوصول.

### المبالغ المستردة والعكس

استرداد كامل أو جزئي عبر المزود، مع سجل بمن أجراه ولماذا.

### بيئة اختبار حقيقية

مفتاح اختبار بجانب مفتاحك الفعلي، ومحاكي، وسفر عبر الزمن لرؤية التجديد يحدث.

### مصمم للوكلاء

skill.md وOpenAPI وخادم MCP وأدوات WebMCP، ليتمكن الذكاء الاصطناعي من إعداد الدفع نيابةً عنك.

للمطورين

## ابدأ بـ curl. وانتهِ بمفتاح ترخيص.

يُشغَّل كل مثال في الوثائق أولًا في بيئة الاختبار بمفتاح اختبار، فيمكنك التجربة بأمان.

[افتح مرجع الواجهة البرمجية](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)

curl MCP JavaScript

```
# 1. register: a live key and a test key, shown once 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/register \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My App","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'

# 2. sell: returns a hosted checkout URL 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_test_… ' \
  -H 'idempotency-key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"my-app","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

```
# any MCP client: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/mcp 
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "wavepay_checkout",
    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
                   "provider": "paynow", "email": "buyer@example.com" } } }

# tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing,
#        wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_subscribe … 
```

```
const res = await fetch("https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "x-wavepay-service-key": process.env.WAVEPAY_KEY,
    "idempotency-key": crypto.randomUUID(),
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ productId: "my-app", planId: "pro",
                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
});
const { checkoutUrl, reference } = await res.json();
```

أسئلة

## إجابات قبل أن تسأل

ما وسائل الدفع التي يمكنني قبولها؟

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through Paynow; Visa, Mastercard and PayPal; and crypto on eleven rails (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron, USDT, USDC). 2Checkout is built and switches on when the provider approves our account.

هل تأخذون نسبة من مبيعاتي؟

Only after your plan's included payments, and the percentage falls as your volume grows (from 2% down to 0.4%, with a small minimum per payment). Provider fees are paid to the provider at cost with no WavePay markup.

هل يمكنني الاختبار دون مال حقيقي؟

نعم. يمنحك التسجيل مفتاح اختبار يستخدم محاكيًا. لا يصل إلى أي مزود ولا يُحتسب ضمن خطتك.

كيف يحصل المشترون على ترخيصهم؟

عند تسوية الدفعة ترسل WavePay مفتاح ترخيص بالبريد، ويمكن لتطبيقك التحقق من الاستحقاق الموقّع دون اتصال.

هل يمكن لوكيل ذكاء اصطناعي استخدام WavePay؟

نعم. وجّهه إلى skill.md أو مستند OpenAPI أو خادم MCP. يستطيع الوكيل التسجيل وتحديد الأسعار والتحصيل والمطابقة دون متصفح.

Source: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/compare-wavepay-vs-2checkout-verifone.html

> 2Checkout, now Verifone, is a merchant of record that sells on your behalf and handles tax; WavePay is not a merchant of record: it routes buyers to payment rails, can…

COMPARE

# WavePay vs 2Checkout (Verifone)

2Checkout, now Verifone, is a merchant of record that sells on your behalf and handles tax; WavePay is not a merchant of record: it routes buyers to payment rails, can use 2Checkout as one of them where it is enabled, and adds Zimbabwean wallets, crypto, licensing and one ledger.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

|  | 2Checkout (Verifone) | WavePay |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Role | Merchant of record: it is the seller to your buyer | A checkout, licensing and ledger layer: your provider account stays the seller |
| Sales tax and invoicing | Handled by 2Checkout as seller | Your responsibility, with the provider you connect |
| Zimbabwean wallets | Not its focus | EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through Paynow |
| Crypto | Check Verifone | Eleven rails quoted in US dollars |
| Availability for your business | Depends on Verifone's seller and payout coverage for your country | WavePay itself has no country gate; each rail has its own |
| 2Checkout as a rail | Native | Built and tested on staging; switched on in production after Verifone approves the account |

## Questions

## Can I use both?

Yes, once 2Checkout is enabled on your deployment: it is one of the rails behind the same checkout call.

## Who is the seller in a WavePay payment?

You are, through the provider account the money lands in. WavePay does not act as merchant of record.

# WavePay vs a card-only payment processor

A card-only processor cannot take a mobile-wallet payment, so buyers who hold EcoCash or OneMoney but not a card cannot pay; WavePay adds those local rails to Visa, Mastercard and PayPal behind the same checkout call.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

|  | Card-only processor | WavePay |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mobile wallets (EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari) | Not offered | Offered; wallet push for EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks and O'mari |
| ZimSwitch | Not offered | Offered |
| Visa / Mastercard / PayPal | Offered | Offered |
| Pricing basis | Typically a percentage of sales | Payments processed: Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month |
| Self-serve for agents | Varies | POST /v2/register, skill.md, MCP tools |

## Questions

## Why add wallets if cards already work?

Because a buyer without a card cannot pay at all; each extra rail is a set of customers who could not otherwise complete the purchase.

## Is a card-only processor ever the better choice?

Yes, when every buyer you serve holds a card and you need nothing else.

# WavePay vs Flutterwave

Flutterwave is a pan-African payment gateway with its own country coverage; WavePay concentrates on Zimbabwean rails, PayPal and crypto behind one agent-ready API with licensing built in, so choose by where your buyers and your business are.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

|  | Flutterwave | WavePay |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Focus | Payments across many African countries | Zimbabwe first, plus international rails |
| Zimbabwean wallets | Check Flutterwave's current Zimbabwe coverage | EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through Paynow |
| Crypto | Check Flutterwave | Eleven rails quoted in US dollars |
| Licence keys | Not part of the product | Built in: signed entitlements verified offline |
| AI agents | Check Flutterwave | MCP tools, skill.md, a one-call registration with no browser |
| Who pays you | Flutterwave settles to you per its terms | The provider you connect pays you directly (own keys), or T3raTech for T3raTech's own products |

## Questions

## Is WavePay a Flutterwave alternative?

For Zimbabwean wallets plus PayPal and crypto behind one API, yes. If your buyers are in countries WavePay's rails do not cover, a pan-African gateway may fit better.

## Can I combine them?

Not today: Flutterwave is not a WavePay rail.

# WavePay vs integrating each payment rail yourself

Integrating each rail yourself means one integration, one reconciliation feed and one failure mode per wallet and card scheme; WavePay replaces them with one checkout call and one ledger, at the cost of depending on WavePay for the rails it enables.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

|  | Each rail yourself | WavePay |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Integrations to build | One per wallet, card scheme and PayPal | One: POST /v2/checkouts |
| Reconciliation | One report per rail | One payments ledger with since/limit cursors |
| Retries | Each integration's own idempotency rules | Idempotency-Key on every checkout |
| Licence keys | Build and run key issuing yourself | Built in: Ed25519 entitlements, offline verification |
| Agent onboarding | Per-provider portals and forms | POST /v2/register or skill.md — no browser |
| Control | Direct relationship with every provider | WavePay sits between you and the provider |

## Questions

## When should I integrate a rail directly?

When you need one rail only, want the direct provider relationship, and are happy to build its reconciliation and licensing yourself.

## When does WavePay make more sense?

When your buyers hold different rails, or when an agent has to set payments up without a browser.

# WavePay vs integrating Paynow directly

Paynow is the Zimbabwean gateway WavePay itself uses for EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch; integrate Paynow directly if you need only Paynow, and use WavePay when you also want PayPal, crypto, subscriptions, licensing and one ledger across rails.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

|  | Paynow directly | WavePay |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Zimbabwean wallets and ZimSwitch | Yes, it is the gateway | Yes, through Paynow: the same wallets, one checkout call |
| Other rails | Not its job | PayPal, crypto on eleven rails, 2Checkout where enabled |
| Fees on a payment | Paynow's own fees, published on its fees page | The same provider fees, paid at cost with no WavePay markup, plus a WavePay plan and a small falling percentage after the included payments |
| Subscriptions and instalments | You build the schedule and the retries | Built in where the rail allows recurring charges |
| Licence keys | You build them | Built in: signed entitlements verified offline |
| Reconciliation | Paynow's reports | One payments ledger across every rail |
| Agent onboarding | Merchant sign-up with Paynow | POST /v2/register or skill.md (you still connect a Paynow account for Paynow payments) |

## Questions

## Does WavePay replace Paynow?

No. WavePay sits in front of Paynow for Zimbabwean wallets and cards; Paynow still takes the payment and charges its own fees.

## When should I use Paynow directly?

When Paynow is your only rail, you are happy to build reconciliation and licensing yourself, and you want no layer between you and the provider.

# WavePay vs integrating PayPal directly

Integrating PayPal directly gives you one rail and its own reconciliation; WavePay puts PayPal, Zimbabwean wallets, cards and crypto behind one checkout and one ledger, and lets a merchant connect their own PayPal account so PayPal still pays them directly.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

|  | PayPal directly | WavePay |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Rails | PayPal (cards and PayPal balance) | PayPal, Paynow wallets and cards, crypto, and 2Checkout where enabled |
| Who is paid | You, if PayPal supports a merchant account in your country | You, through your own PayPal account (own keys), or T3raTech for T3raTech's own sales |
| Reconciliation | PayPal's reports | One payments ledger across every rail |
| Licence keys | Build your own | Built in: Ed25519 entitlements, offline verification |
| Agent onboarding | Developer portal and app review | POST /v2/register or skill.md |

## Questions

## Do I still need a PayPal account?

To receive PayPal payments yourself, yes: with own keys you connect your own PayPal account and PayPal pays you directly.

## Why use WavePay if PayPal pays me directly anyway?

For the rails PayPal does not cover for your buyers, the single ledger and webhook format, the licensing, and the agent-ready onboarding.

# Compare WavePay with PayPal, Paynow, 2Checkout, Flutterwave and…

> How WavePay compares with integrating PayPal, Paynow, 2Checkout (Verifone) or Flutterwave directly, with a card-only processor, or with building each payment rail…

COMPARE

# Compare WavePay with PayPal, Paynow, 2Checkout, Flutterwave and doing it yourself

How WavePay compares with integrating PayPal, Paynow, 2Checkout (Verifone) or Flutterwave directly, with a card-only processor, or with building each payment rail yourself.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

### [WavePay vs integrating each payment rail yourself](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/compare-wavepay-vs-integrating-each-rail.html)

Integrating each rail yourself means one integration, one reconciliation feed and one failure mode per wallet and card scheme; WavePay replaces them with one checkout call and one ledger, at the cost of depending on WavePay for the rails it enables.

### [WavePay vs a card-only payment processor](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/compare-wavepay-vs-card-only-processor.html)

A card-only processor cannot take a mobile-wallet payment, so buyers who hold EcoCash or OneMoney but not a card cannot pay; WavePay adds those local rails to Visa, Mastercard and PayPal behind the same checkout call.

### [WavePay vs integrating PayPal directly](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/compare-wavepay-vs-paypal-direct.html)

Integrating PayPal directly gives you one rail and its own reconciliation; WavePay puts PayPal, Zimbabwean wallets, cards and crypto behind one checkout and one ledger, and lets a merchant connect their own PayPal account so PayPal still pays them directly.

### [WavePay vs integrating Paynow directly](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/compare-wavepay-vs-paynow-direct.html)

Paynow is the Zimbabwean gateway WavePay itself uses for EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch; integrate Paynow directly if you need only Paynow, and use WavePay when you also want PayPal, crypto, subscriptions, licensing and one ledger across rails.

### [WavePay vs 2Checkout (Verifone)](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/compare-wavepay-vs-2checkout-verifone.html)

2Checkout, now Verifone, is a merchant of record that sells on your behalf and handles tax; WavePay is not a merchant of record: it routes buyers to payment rails, can use 2Checkout as one of them where it is enabled, and adds Zimbabwean wallets, crypto, licensing and one ledger.

### [WavePay vs Flutterwave](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/compare-wavepay-vs-flutterwave.html)

Flutterwave is a pan-African payment gateway with its own country coverage; WavePay concentrates on Zimbabwean rails, PayPal and crypto behind one agent-ready API with licensing built in, so choose by where your buyers and your business are.

## How to choose

WavePay is a checkout, licensing and ledger layer. It does not replace the provider that takes the money: it puts the providers behind one call. Choose a provider directly when you need exactly that provider, you want no layer between you and it, and you are happy to build reconciliation, retries and licensing yourself. Choose WavePay when you need several rails (Zimbabwean wallets, cards, PayPal, crypto), subscriptions or licence keys, or an integration an AI agent can run on its own.

Statements about other providers describe their public positioning; provider terms, fees and country coverage change, so confirm them on the provider's own pages before you decide.

> The cookies and storage this website uses: a theme preference, Google Analytics 4 and ShareThis, what each is for and how to refuse analytics.

LEGAL

# Cookies and similar technologies

The cookies and storage this website uses: a theme preference, Google Analytics 4 and ShareThis, what each is for and how to refuse analytics.

Updated 2026-10-31 · TeraTech Solutions (Private) Limited

## What this means

We use few. The ones that make the site work need no consent; analytics and sharing use cookies you can refuse.

## Strictly necessary

- `wp_theme`: remembers your light, dark or system choice so the page does not flash. Stored for up to a year.
- Language: your language is the page you are on (for example /fr/); no cookie is needed.

## Analytics

Google Analytics 4 measures page views and interactions so we can improve the site. It sets cookies such as `_ga`. You can refuse by turning on Do Not Track or a tracking blocker, or by opting out through Google's browser add-on. We use it for aggregate numbers, not to build profiles.

## Sharing

The share buttons in the footer are provided by ShareThis, which may set its own cookies when the buttons load. Plain share links are used if scripts are blocked.

## Checkout and sign-in

The hosted checkout and your provider's pages set whatever cookies the provider needs; those are governed by the provider's policy.

# Crypto payment API: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Litecoin…

> WavePay takes crypto on eleven rails — Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron, USDT on three networks and USDC — by quoting the US-dollar price at a…

USE CASE

# Crypto payment API: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron, USDT and USDC

WavePay takes crypto on eleven rails — Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron, USDT on three networks and USDC — by quoting the US-dollar price at a fresh rate, showing the exact amount and address, and settling the payment when the exchange credits the deposit.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## The flow

1. Pay: POST /v2/checkouts with provider crypto and method set to a rail id from GET /v2/crypto/rails.
2. The exact amount, down to the last digit, is how a deposit is matched to one payment, so no memo or tag is needed.
3. The rate is at most ten minutes old when quoted; a quote stays payable for six hours.
4. Today these are T3raTech's own addresses for T3raTech's own sales; merchant-owned wallets are a separate, later settlement type.

## Questions

## Why is XRP not offered?

XRP needs a destination tag, and a transfer without one can be lost, so it is left out until it can be handled safely.

## Who holds the crypto?

For T3raTech's own sales, T3raTech's exchange account. WavePay does not hold crypto for other merchants.

# WavePay — Zahlungen und Lizenzen für Software

> Nehmen Sie EcoCash, Karten und PayPal mit einer API an. In einer Anfrage registrieren, mit Spielgeld testen und dann mit Lizenzen, Abos und Erstattungen live gehen.

Now with crypto, subscriptions and your own PayPal account

# Lassen Sie sich für Ihre Software bezahlen auf *jedem Weg, den Ihre Kunden nutzen*

Eine API für EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, ZimSwitch, Karten und PayPal. In einer Anfrage registrieren, mit Spielgeld testen und mit eingebauten Lizenzen, Abos und Erstattungen live gehen.

[Kostenlos starten](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.html#register) [Dokumentation lesen](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html) [Für Agenten](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md)

- Kostenloser Tarif, keine Karte nötig
- A fee that falls as you grow
- REST und MCP

**20**payment methods

**25**kostenlose Zahlungen pro Monat

**2%→0.4%**usage fee, falling with volume

**15**Sprachen

Zahlungsarten

## Jede Zahlungsart, die ein Käufer haben könnte

Zimbabwean wallets, cards, PayPal and eleven crypto rails. The providers endpoint always says what is live today.

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal Bitcoin Ethereum Solana BNB Litecoin Dogecoin Tron USDT USDC 2Checkout · demnächst

Was Sie bekommen

## Der Checkout ist der leichte Teil. WavePay ist der Rest.

### Gehosteter Checkout und Wallet-Anfrage

Schicken Sie Käufer auf eine gehostete Seite oder senden Sie eine EcoCash-Anfrage direkt aufs Handy.

### Lizenzierung eingebaut

Signierte Berechtigungen, Lizenzschlüssel per E-Mail, Geräteaktivierung und Wiederherstellung. Ihre App prüft offline.

### Abos und Ratenzahlung

Wiederkehrende Pläne, Kartenzahlung später und eine klare Verzugsfrist, bevor der Zugang endet.

### Erstattungen und Rückbuchungen

Volle und teilweise Erstattungen über den Anbieter, mit Nachweis, wer sie warum veranlasst hat.

### Eine echte Testumgebung

Ein Testschlüssel neben Ihrem Live-Schlüssel, ein Simulator und Zeitreise, um eine Verlängerung zu beobachten.

### Für Agenten gebaut

skill.md, OpenAPI, ein MCP-Server und WebMCP-Werkzeuge: Eine KI kann den Checkout für Sie einrichten.

So funktioniert es

## Drei Anfragen von null bis bezahlt

1

### Registrieren

Eine Anfrage liefert einen Live- und einen Testschlüssel. Kostenloser Tarif, sofort aktiv.

2

### Verkaufen

Erstellen Sie einen Checkout und erhalten Sie eine gehostete URL oder senden Sie eine Wallet-Anfrage ans Handy.

3

### Abwickeln

Ein signierter Webhook oder eine Abfrage bestätigt das Geld. Der Lizenzschlüssel geht automatisch per E-Mail raus.

Für Entwickler

## Mit curl anfangen. Mit einem Lizenzschlüssel enden.

Jedes Beispiel der Dokumentation läuft zuerst mit einem Testschlüssel in der Sandbox, damit Sie gefahrlos ausprobieren können.

[API-Referenz öffnen](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)

curl MCP JavaScript

```
# 1. register: a live key and a test key, shown once 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/register \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My App","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'

# 2. sell: returns a hosted checkout URL 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_test_… ' \
  -H 'idempotency-key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"my-app","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

```
# any MCP client: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/mcp 
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "wavepay_checkout",
    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
                   "provider": "paynow", "email": "buyer@example.com" } } }

# tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing,
#        wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_subscribe … 
```

```
const res = await fetch("https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "x-wavepay-service-key": process.env.WAVEPAY_KEY,
    "idempotency-key": crypto.randomUUID(),
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ productId: "my-app", planId: "pro",
                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
});
const { checkoutUrl, reference } = await res.json();
```

Fragen

## Antworten, bevor Sie fragen

Welche Zahlungsarten kann ich annehmen?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through Paynow; Visa, Mastercard and PayPal; and crypto on eleven rails (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron, USDT, USDC). 2Checkout is built and switches on when the provider approves our account.

Nehmen Sie einen Prozentsatz meiner Umsätze?

Only after your plan's included payments, and the percentage falls as your volume grows (from 2% down to 0.4%, with a small minimum per payment). Provider fees are paid to the provider at cost with no WavePay markup.

Kann ich ohne echtes Geld testen?

Ja. Die Registrierung gibt Ihnen einen Testschlüssel mit Simulator. Er erreicht nie einen Anbieter und zählt nicht auf Ihren Plan.

Wie erhalten Käufer ihre Lizenz?

Sobald eine Zahlung abgewickelt ist, sendet WavePay einen Lizenzschlüssel per E-Mail, und Ihre App kann die signierte Berechtigung offline prüfen.

Kann ein KI-Agent WavePay nutzen?

Ja. Verweisen Sie ihn auf skill.md, das OpenAPI-Dokument oder den MCP-Server. Ein Agent kann sich registrieren, Preise setzen, kassieren und abgleichen, ganz ohne Browser.

# Developer-first payment API: idempotent checkouts, signed…

> WavePay is a developer-first payment API: register with one POST, get a live key and a test key, create idempotent checkouts, receive HMAC-signed settlement webhooks…

USE CASE

# Developer-first payment API: idempotent checkouts, signed webhooks, a test mode with fake money

WavePay is a developer-first payment API: register with one POST, get a live key and a test key, create idempotent checkouts, receive HMAC-signed settlement webhooks, and read every payment from a cursor-paged ledger — all described in a public OpenAPI file.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## The flow

1. Start: POST /v2/register returns a live key and a test key (mk_test_…) that settles through a simulator, with fake money.
2. Safe retries: every checkout takes an Idempotency-Key, so a retried request returns the same checkout.
3. Settle: signed webhooks (X-WavePay-Signature) or the payments ledger with since/limit cursors.
4. Reference: /openapi.json, /docs.html, /skill.md and /llms.txt describe every route.

## Questions

## Is there a sandbox?

Yes. The test key uses the same routes with fake money and never reaches a provider or counts against your plan.

## Where is the API reference?

openapi.json, docs.html and skill.md, all generated from the same source as the Worker.

# Docs — WavePay

> WavePay developer documentation: merchant registration, checkouts on every rail, wallet push, licensing, webhooks, the payments ledger and MCP tools for agents.

Developer docs

# The whole API in one page

Base URL: `https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev`. Public endpoints are rate-limited per client. Merchant endpoints take your key in the `x-wavepay-service-key` header. Agents: [skill.md](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md) is the same reference shaped for autonomous clients; `POST /mcp` speaks JSON-RPC tools.

### 0 · Register — no browser

```
POST /v2/register
{ "name": "My Product", "ownerEmail": "you@x.com" }
// 201 → { "merchantId": "mer_…", "key": "mk_live_…",
//         "planId": "free", "paymentsPerMonth": 25 }
// The key is shown once — only its hash is stored.
```

One registration per email; 5/day per client. A lost key is re-minted by the operator against the owner email.

### 1 · Start a checkout

```
POST /v2/checkouts
Idempotency-Key: <stable per order>
{
  "productId": "your-product",
  "planId": "pro",
  "provider": "paynow",        // "paynow-mobile" | "paypal"
  "email": "buyer@x.com",
  "phone": "+2637…"            // express wallet push only
}
// 201 → { "checkoutUrl": "…", "reference": "pay_…" }
```

Hand the buyer `checkoutUrl`. With `paynow-mobile` + `phone`, the wallet prompt pushes straight to the handset — no page at all.

### 2 · Watch it settle

```
GET /v2/checkouts/<reference>/status
// 200 → { "status": "pending" | "collected" | "expired" }

// settlement push instead — register a webhook on your site:
POST /v2/internal/sites/webhook
x-wavepay-service-key: mk_live_…
{ "siteId": "…", "url": "https://you.dev/hook" }
// → returns the HMAC secret once; settlements sign with it.
```

### 3 · Catalogue and pricing

```
GET /v2/providers                   // live rails
GET /v2/pricing?productId=…         // plans, prices, promotions

GET /v2/internal/merchant/catalog   // with your key —
// the sites, plans and coupons your merchant sees
```

### MCP — tools for agents

```
POST /mcp                       // JSON-RPC 2.0
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}
// wavepay_register · wavepay_providers · wavepay_pricing
// wavepay_checkout · wavepay_checkout_status · wavepay_catalog
// Merchant tools read the key from the request's
// x-wavepay-service-key header, same as REST.
```

### Licensing (optional, built in)

```
POST /v2/licensing/checkout    // sells + emails a licence key
POST /v2/licensing/activate    // { "licenseKey", "deviceId" } → signed entitlement
POST /v2/licensing/recover     // mails the buyer a fresh key
GET  /v2/licensing/public-key  // Ed25519 trust root — verify entitlements offline
```

T3rnel Browser sells Pro on this exact flow in production.

### Merchant endpoints

| Endpoint | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /v2/internal/payments` | Your settlement ledger — idempotent drain with `since`/`limit` cursors |
| `POST /v2/internal/coupons/mint` | Mint discount codes on your products (Basic+) |
| `GET /v2/internal/merchant/catalog` | Everything your key can sell: sites, plans, live prices |
| `GET/PUT/DELETE /v2/internal/merchant/settlement[/{provider}]` | Connect your own PayPal account so payments land with you; credentials are checked, sealed and never returned |
| `GET /v2/price-list` | WavePay's own price list: plans, usage schedule, modes (also [/pricing.json](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.json)) |
| `GET /v2/internal/merchant/invoices` | Your usage invoices: month, amount, status |
| `GET /v2/crypto/rails` | The crypto rails and which can be quoted right now; pay with `provider: "crypto"` and `method` set to a rail id |
| `GET /v2/internal/merchant/usage` | Your usage meter for the month and the total due |
| `POST /v2/internal/sites/webhook` | Set the settlement webhook for a site (secret returned once) |
| `POST /v2/test/settle` | Test-mode settlement — exercise the webhook end-to-end, no money moves |
| `POST /v2/test/billing/run` | Test key only — run the billing engine as if `advanceDays` had passed, to exercise renewals, instalments and dunning |
| `GET /v2/features` | Which flagged capabilities are on for live money (test keys can use all of them) |
| `POST /v2/internal/subscriptions` | Open a subscription (needs `Idempotency-Key`); `GET` lists, `/cancel` ends |
| `POST /v2/internal/bnpl` | Buy now, pay later on a card: deposit now, instalments until the total is paid |
| `POST /v2/internal/refunds` | Refund a settled PayPal or test payment, in part or in full |
| `POST /v2/internal/subscriptions/pause` | Pause a subscription (also at 2Checkout); `/resume` undoes it, `/price` changes the renewal price |
| `POST /v2/twocheckout/ipn` | 2Checkout's signed order, renewal, refund and chargeback notifications (and `/lcn` for subscription changes) — called by 2Checkout, not by you |
| `POST /v2/internal/checkouts/otp` | Complete an O'mari payment with the buyer's one-time PIN |

### Test mode

`POST /v2/register` returns `key` (`mk_live_…`) and `testKey` (`mk_test_…`). A test key calls the same routes but settles through a simulator that never contacts a provider and never counts against your cap. Choose the outcome with Paynow's test phones: `0771111111` paid, `0772222222` paid after ten seconds, `0773333333` cancelled, `0774444444` failed; or tag the email (`+decline`, `+cancel`, `+delay`). A test checkout's URL is a hosted page with Approve and Decline buttons. Read [the test-mode guide](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/guide-test-mode.html).

### Subscriptions, instalments and refunds

**Automatic** collection charges a saved card (Paynow card tokens, once Paynow has approved them for the deployment) or a PayPal subscription. **invoice_and_remind** sends a payment request each period and is the only mode for EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks and O'mari, which cannot be debited unattended. **BNPL** takes a deposit and collects the rest from a non-prepaid card until the total is paid; WavePay collects, it does not lend. **Refunds** work for PayPal and test payments; Paynow documents no refund API. These are switched on per deployment — check `GET /v2/features`. See [recurring payments](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/guide-recurring-payments.html) and [buy now, pay later](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/guide-buy-now-pay-later.html).

### Rails and rules

**paynow** — hosted PayNow checkout: Visa, Mastercard, ZimSwitch, EcoCash, OneMoney, Telecash, InnBucks, O'mari. **paynow-mobile** — express wallet push to a phone. **twocheckout** — Verifone's 2Checkout: international cards and PayPal, merchant of record, 2Checkout-billed subscriptions, refunds, signed IPN/LCN notifications. **paypal** — international buyers, USD. Prices are minor units (900 = $9.00). Free tier caps at 25 payments/30 days — the cap refuses checkouts as `MERCHANT_LIMIT_REACHED`, never mid-payment. Idempotency-Key retries return the same checkout; `mk_test_…` keys run every route with fake money.

The same API as MCP tools, plus the machine-readable files agents read.

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | JSON-RPC response |

#### Example

```

```

# Subscriptions, instalments and refunds

Recurring charges, buy-now-pay-later schedules and refunds.

Open a subscription (flag: recurring; test keys always)

Authentication: Merchant key in x-wavepay-service-key

#### Parameters

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | yes | string |

#### Body (JSON)

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `productId` | string | yes |
| `planId` | string | yes |
| `provider` | paynow \| paynow-mobile \| paypal | yes |
| `email` | string | yes |
| `phone` | string | no |
| `externalSubject` | string | yes |
| `collection` | automatic \| invoice_and_remind | no |
| `method` | string | no |

#### Responses

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 201 | OK |
| 403 | FEATURE_DISABLED (flag off for live money) or MERCHANT_SCOPE |

#### Example

```
curl -sX POST https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/internal/subscriptions \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_live_…' \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"productId":"…","planId":"…","provider":"paynow","email":"…","phone":"…","externalSubject":"…","collection":"automatic","method":"…"}'
```

Global key: store coin prices in US dollars (a checkout refuses a rate older than ten minutes)

Authentication: Global service key (operator only)

#### Responses

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | { ok, coins } |
| 400 | unknown coin or a price that is not positive |

#### Example

```
curl -sX POST https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/internal/crypto/rates \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: <global key>'
```

Global key: open crypto payments with rail, exact base-unit amount and address — what the watcher looks for

Authentication: Global service key (operator only)

#### Responses

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | { payments: [{ reference, rail, baseUnits, address, createdAt }] } |

#### Example

```
curl -sX POST https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/internal/crypto/pending \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: <global key>'
```

Global key: settle a payment from a deposit the exchange credited. Re-verified: rail, address, exact amount, and the transaction never settled a payment before

Authentication: Global service key (operator only)

#### Responses

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | the payment's status |
| 409 | TRANSFER_ALREADY_USED |
| 422 | PAYMENT_MISMATCH — not the deposit that was asked for |

#### Example

```
curl -sX POST https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/internal/crypto/settle \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: <global key>'
```

# Errors

Every error is JSON, `{ "error": { "code": "…" } }`, with the HTTP status below.

| Code | HTTP | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `INVALID_AMOUNT` | 400 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `INVALID_CURRENCY` | 400 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `INVALID_OTP` | 400 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `INVALID_REQUEST` | 400 | The request is malformed or a field is missing or not allowed. |
| `PROMO_CODE_INVALID` | 400 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `PROOF_EXPIRED` | 400 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `SETTLEMENT_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED` | 400 | That provider cannot be connected as your own account. |
| `INVALID_DEVICE_PROOF` | 401 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `PROVIDER_SIGNATURE_INVALID` | 401 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `SERVICE_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | The x-wavepay-service-key header is missing, wrong or revoked. |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Missing or wrong credentials. |
| `CHARGE_DECLINED` | 402 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `CHECKOUT_ASSOCIATION_DENIED` | 403 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `FEATURE_DISABLED` | 403 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `LICENSE_REVOKED` | 403 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `LIVE_KEY_REQUIRED` | 403 | A test key cannot do this; use your live key. |
| `MERCHANT_SCOPE` | 403 | Your key may not touch this resource (it belongs to another merchant, or the route needs the global key). |
| `MERCHANT_SCOPE_REQUIRED` | 403 | This route needs a merchant key, not the global key. |
| `NOT_A_TEST_KEY` | 403 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `RESERVATION_ASSOCIATION_DENIED` | 403 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `ACTIVATION_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `BNPL_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `COUPON_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `KEY_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `LICENSE_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `MERCHANT_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `PLAN_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `PROMOTION_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `RECOVERY_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `SITE_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `UNKNOWN_CHECKOUT` | 404 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `UNKNOWN_LICENSE` | 404 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `COLLECTION_NOT_SUPPORTED` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `COUPON_ALREADY_REDEEMED` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `COUPON_NOT_REDEEMABLE` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `ENTITLEMENT_UNAVAILABLE` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` | 409 | The same Idempotency-Key was used with a different request. |
| `LICENSE_ACTIVATION_LIMIT_REACHED` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `LICENSE_NOT_READY` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `LICENSING_DISABLED` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `MERCHANT_ALREADY_REGISTERED` | 409 | That owner email already has a merchant. |
| `NO_CONTACT` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `NOT_A_TEST_PAYMENT` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `OTP_UNSUPPORTED` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `PAYMENT_NOT_APPROVED` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `PAYMENT_NOT_READY` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `PAYMENT_NOT_REFUNDABLE` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `PAYMENT_REPLAY` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `PLAN_NOT_RECURRING` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `PROMO_CODE_EXHAUSTED` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `PROMO_CODE_REVOKED` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `PROMOTION_NOT_ACTIVE` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `PROVIDER_DISABLED` | 409 | That provider is not enabled on this deployment, or the merchant's account for it cannot be used. |
| `REFUND_EXCEEDS_PAYMENT` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `REFUND_REFUSED` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `REFUND_UNSUPPORTED` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `RESERVATION_STATE_CONFLICT` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `RESERVATION_UNAVAILABLE` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_ACTIVE` | 409 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `TRANSFER_ALREADY_USED` | 409 | That transaction already settled a payment. |
| `CREDENTIALS_REJECTED` | 422 | The provider refused the credentials you connected. |
| `ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH` | 422 | Sandbox credentials on a live deployment, or the reverse. |
| `PAYMENT_MISMATCH` | 422 | The payment, amount or address does not match what was asked for. |
| `MERCHANT_LIMIT_REACHED` | 429 | The Free plan's monthly allowance is used. Paid plans are never refused: they are charged by usage. |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | Too many requests; wait and retry. |
| `PROVIDER_AUTH_FAILED` | 502 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `PROVIDER_RESPONSE_INVALID` | 502 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` | 502 | The provider could not be reached; retry. |
| `CONFIGURATION_ERROR` | 503 | See the operation that returned it. |
| `CRYPTO_BUSY` | 503 | Every payable amount for that coin is taken by open payments; retry shortly. |
| `RATE_UNAVAILABLE` | 503 | No crypto price newer than ten minutes for that coin; retry shortly. |
| `SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT_UNUSABLE` | 503 | Your connected account's credentials stopped working; reconnect it. The payment is refused, never paid to anyone else. |

Source: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs/

> Register, test with fake money and take a payment: the WavePay API reference start page, with conventions for money, idempotency and errors.

API reference

# Get started

[Download the whole reference as Markdown](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/wavepay-docs.md)

Base URL: `https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev`. JSON in, JSON out. Everything under `/v2/internal/` takes your key in the `x-wavepay-service-key` header; checkout pages and the price list are public.

## 1. Register

One call creates your merchant and returns a live key and a test key. Both are shown once and only their hashes are stored.

```
curl -sX POST https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/register \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My product","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'
```

## 2. Test with fake money

The `mk_test_…` key uses the same routes and settles through a simulator. It never reaches a provider and never counts against your plan.

## 3. Take a payment

```
curl -sX POST https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"my-product","planId":"growth","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

Send the buyer to `checkoutUrl`, then read `GET /v2/checkouts/<reference>/status` or receive the signed webhook. Providers: `paynow`, `paynow-mobile`, `paypal`, `crypto` (set `method` to a rail id) and `twocheckout` where enabled.

## Conventions

- **Money** is in minor units (cents). **Idempotency**: send an `Idempotency-Key` on every checkout; a repeat returns the same checkout.
- **Errors** are `{"error":{"code":"…"}}` with a meaningful HTTP status; see [Errors](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs/errors.html).
- **One page for models:** [wavepay-docs.md](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/wavepay-docs.md) is this whole reference as a single Markdown file, and [llms.txt](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/llms.txt) indexes the site.
- **Security:** Secrets are shown once and stored only as hashes (merchant keys) or sealed with AES-GCM (provider credentials, buyer addresses); they are never logged or returned. [How we protect your keys and data](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/security.html).

> Connect your own provider account so the provider pays you directly. WavePay never holds your money in this mode.

API reference

# Where the money lands

Connect your own provider account so the provider pays you directly. WavePay never holds your money in this mode.

The provider accounts your key has connected (masked); the secret is never returned

Authentication: Merchant key in x-wavepay-service-key

#### Responses

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | { accounts: [{ provider, mode: 'own-keys', environment, account, status, connectedAt, verifiedAt }] } |
| 403 | a global key, which has no merchant |

#### Example

```
curl -sX GET https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/internal/merchant/settlement \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_live_…'
```

Connect your own provider account so the money lands with you (own keys). Credentials are checked with the provider, sealed, and never returned

Authentication: Merchant key in x-wavepay-service-key

#### Parameters

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | path | yes | string |

#### Body (JSON)

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clientId` | string | yes |
| `clientSecret` | string | yes |
| `environment` | sandbox \| production | no |

#### Responses

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | { account: { provider, mode, environment, account, status, connectedAt, verifiedAt } } |
| 400 | SETTLEMENT_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED or INVALID_REQUEST |
| 403 | LIVE_KEY_REQUIRED (a test key cannot hold an account) or a global key |
| 422 | CREDENTIALS_REJECTED (the provider refused them) or ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH (sandbox keys on a production Worker, or the reverse) |

#### Example

```
curl -sX PUT https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/internal/merchant/settlement/<provider> \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_live_…' \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"clientId":"…","clientSecret":"…","environment":"sandbox"}'
```

Disconnect the account; later payments settle through the deployment's account again

Authentication: Merchant key in x-wavepay-service-key

#### Parameters

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | path | yes | string |

#### Responses

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | { disconnected: boolean } |

#### Example

```
curl -sX DELETE https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/internal/merchant/settlement/<provider> \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_live_…'
```

Source: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/es/

# WavePay — pagos y licencias para software

> Acepta EcoCash, tarjetas y PayPal con una sola API. Regístrate en una solicitud, prueba con dinero ficticio y pasa a producción con licencias, suscripciones y reembolsos.

Now with crypto, subscriptions and your own PayPal account

# Cobra por tu software en *todos los medios de pago que usan tus clientes*

Una API para EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, ZimSwitch, tarjetas y PayPal. Regístrate en una solicitud, prueba con dinero ficticio y pasa a producción con licencias, suscripciones y reembolsos incluidos.

[Empieza gratis](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.html#register) [Leer la documentación](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html) [Para agentes](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md)

- Plan gratuito, sin tarjeta
- A fee that falls as you grow
- REST y MCP

**20**payment methods

**25**pagos gratis al mes

**2%→0.4%**usage fee, falling with volume

**15**idiomas

Medios de pago

## Todos los medios que un comprador puede tener

Zimbabwean wallets, cards, PayPal and eleven crypto rails. The providers endpoint always says what is live today.

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal Bitcoin Ethereum Solana BNB Litecoin Dogecoin Tron USDT USDC 2Checkout · próximamente

Qué obtienes

## Cobrar es la parte fácil. WavePay es el resto.

### Pago alojado y solicitud a la cartera

Envía a los compradores a una página alojada o lanza una solicitud de EcoCash directamente a su teléfono.

### Licencias integradas

Derechos firmados, claves de licencia por correo, activación de dispositivos y recuperación. Tu aplicación verifica sin conexión.

### Suscripciones y pagos a plazos

Planes recurrentes, compra ahora y paga después con tarjeta, y un plazo claro de demora antes de que termine el acceso.

### Reembolsos y reversiones

Reembolsos totales o parciales a través del proveedor, con constancia de quién lo hizo y por qué.

### Un entorno de pruebas real

Una clave de prueba junto a tu clave real, un simulador y viaje en el tiempo para ver una renovación.

### Hecho para agentes

skill.md, OpenAPI, un servidor MCP y herramientas WebMCP: una IA puede configurar el pago por ti.

Cómo funciona

## Tres solicitudes de cero a cobrado

1

### Registrarte

Una solicitud devuelve una clave real y una clave de prueba. Plan gratuito, activo al instante.

2

### Vender

Crea un pago y obtén una URL alojada, o lanza una solicitud a un teléfono.

3

### Liquidar

Un webhook firmado o una consulta confirma el dinero. La clave de licencia se envía sola.

Para desarrolladores

## Empieza con curl. Termina con una clave de licencia.

Cada ejemplo de la documentación se ejecuta primero en el entorno de pruebas con una clave de prueba, así puedes romper cosas sin riesgo.

[Abrir la referencia de la API](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)

curl MCP JavaScript

```
# 1. register: a live key and a test key, shown once 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/register \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My App","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'

# 2. sell: returns a hosted checkout URL 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_test_… ' \
  -H 'idempotency-key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"my-app","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

```
# any MCP client: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/mcp 
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "wavepay_checkout",
    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
                   "provider": "paynow", "email": "buyer@example.com" } } }

# tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing,
#        wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_subscribe … 
```

```
const res = await fetch("https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "x-wavepay-service-key": process.env.WAVEPAY_KEY,
    "idempotency-key": crypto.randomUUID(),
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ productId: "my-app", planId: "pro",
                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
});
const { checkoutUrl, reference } = await res.json();
```

Preguntas

## Respuestas antes de que preguntes

¿Qué medios de pago puedo aceptar?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through Paynow; Visa, Mastercard and PayPal; and crypto on eleven rails (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron, USDT, USDC). 2Checkout is built and switches on when the provider approves our account.

¿Cobráis un porcentaje de mis ventas?

Only after your plan's included payments, and the percentage falls as your volume grows (from 2% down to 0.4%, with a small minimum per payment). Provider fees are paid to the provider at cost with no WavePay markup.

¿Puedo probar sin dinero real?

Sí. El registro te da una clave de prueba que usa un simulador. Nunca llega a un proveedor y no cuenta para tu plan.

¿Cómo reciben los compradores su licencia?

Cuando un pago se liquida, WavePay envía una clave de licencia por correo y tu aplicación puede verificar el derecho firmado sin conexión.

¿Puede un agente de IA usar WavePay?

Sí. Indícale skill.md, el documento OpenAPI o el servidor MCP. Un agente puede registrarse, fijar precios, cobrar y conciliar sin navegador.

# WavePay FAQ · WavePay

> WavePay is the checkout, licensing and settlement API for software — apps, browser extensions, games, APIs and bots.

QUESTIONS

# Frequently asked questions

WavePay is the checkout, licensing and settlement API for software — apps, browser extensions, games, APIs and bots. One integration reaches Zimbabwean wallets (EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari, ZimSwitch) and international rails (Visa, Mastercard, PayPal).

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## What is WavePay?

WavePay is the checkout, licensing and settlement API for software — apps, browser extensions, games, APIs and bots. One integration reaches Zimbabwean wallets (EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari, ZimSwitch) and international rails (Visa, Mastercard, PayPal).

## How do I start accepting payments?

Two calls. POST /v2/register with a name and an email returns a live merchant key (mk_live_…) once; POST /v2/checkouts with that product and plan returns a hosted checkout URL. The free tier works immediately — 25 payments per 30 days.

## Does WavePay take a percentage of my sales?

Only after your plan's included payments, and the percentage falls as your volume grows (2% down to 0.4%, with a small minimum per payment). The plan fee covers the software: Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month. Provider fees are paid to the provider at cost with no WavePay markup. Full schedule: /pricing.html and /pricing.json.

## Which payment methods can my customers use?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch for Zimbabwean buyers; Visa, Mastercard and PayPal for international buyers. Which are enabled on a deployment is reported live by GET /v2/providers.

## Can an AI agent set up and run payments by itself?

Yes. skill.md is the whole onboarding in one markdown file, and POST /mcp exposes JSON-RPC tools (wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing, wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_catalog). No browser, OAuth or email round-trip is needed.

## How do I know a payment landed?

Poll GET /v2/checkouts/<reference>/status (pending, collected or expired) or register a signed webhook. Every settlement is also in the payments ledger, which you can drain idempotently with since/limit cursors.

## Can a retry charge a customer twice?

No. POST /v2/checkouts takes an Idempotency-Key; repeating a request with the same key returns the same checkout instead of creating a second one.

## Does WavePay issue licence keys?

Yes. Licensing is built in: a paid checkout emails a licence key, devices activate it for an Ed25519-signed entitlement, and your app verifies that entitlement offline against the public key at GET /v2/licensing/public-key.

## Can I charge someone without a browser?

Yes, for EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks and O'mari: use provider paynow-mobile with the buyer's phone number and the wallet prompt is pushed straight to the handset to approve with a PIN. The wallet a deployment pushes to is part of its configuration — GET /v2/providers shows it. Games and bots, where a hosted page cannot open, use this.

## Can I test without moving money?

Yes. POST /v2/register returns a test key (mk_test_…) beside your live one. A test key uses the same routes, settles through a simulator that never contacts a provider, and never counts against your payment cap. Paynow's own test phone numbers choose the outcome: 0771111111 pays, 0772222222 pays after ten seconds, 0773333333 cancels, 0774444444 fails. POST /v2/test/billing/run advances time so renewals and instalments can be tested without waiting, and POST /v2/test/settle exercises your webhook end to end.

## Can I charge customers every month?

Yes, as subscriptions. A saved card (where Paynow has approved card tokens for the deployment) or a PayPal subscription is charged automatically. EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks and O'mari cannot be debited without the customer, so each period the customer is sent a fresh payment prompt and their access follows what they actually pay. GET /v2/features reports which of these a deployment has switched on for live money; a test key can use all of them today.

## Can customers buy now and pay later?

Yes, on cards. The customer pays a deposit, the rest is collected from that card on a schedule, and collection continues until the total is paid. Prepaid cards and virtual cards are refused because they can be emptied or closed after delivery. WavePay collects; it does not lend, so the merchant carries the risk that a card stops working, which is why access is suspended after a grace period of missed payments and restored when payment resumes. Mobile wallets are not offered BNPL because they cannot be debited unattended.

## Does WavePay work with 2Checkout (Verifone)?

Yes. Provider twocheckout is Verifone's 2Checkout: international cards and PayPal with 2Checkout as merchant of record, so it handles tax and invoicing. A one-time checkout is a signed 2Checkout link settled by signed IPN; a subscription with collection=automatic is billed by 2Checkout itself, and WavePay records each renewal, refund and chargeback from its signed notifications. GET /v2/providers lists it wherever it is enabled.

## Can I refund a payment?

Yes for PayPal payments and for test payments: POST /v2/internal/refunds with an Idempotency-Key refunds all or part of a settled payment, never more than was paid. Paynow documents no refund API, so a Paynow payment is refused with REFUND_UNSUPPORTED rather than recorded as refunded; refund those from the Paynow dashboard.

## What happens when I hit my plan's payment cap?

New checkouts are refused with MERCHANT_LIMIT_REACHED. A buyer who is already mid-payment is never blocked or double-charged.

## Who runs WavePay?

WavePay is built by T3raTech (TeraTech Solutions (Private) Limited). T3rnel Browser sells its Pro tier on this rail in production.

# 2Checkout (Verifone) with WavePay: checkout, subscriptions…

> WavePay sells through 2Checkout as provider twocheckout: a signed buy-link for one-time purchases, 2Checkout-billed subscriptions with every renewal recorded from a…

HOW IT WORKS

# 2Checkout (Verifone) with WavePay: checkout, subscriptions, refunds and notifications

WavePay sells through 2Checkout as provider twocheckout: a signed buy-link for one-time purchases, 2Checkout-billed subscriptions with every renewal recorded from a signed notification, refunds through its REST API, and HMAC-signed IPN and LCN webhooks, with 2Checkout acting as merchant of record for tax and invoicing.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## One-time checkout

POST /v2/checkouts with provider twocheckout returns a link signed with your buy-link secret word. The price, currency, reference and a 24-hour expiry are inside the signature, so none can be edited in the URL. Settlement is proven by the signed IPN or the REST order lookup, never by the redirect alone.

## Subscriptions billed by 2Checkout

Create a subscription with collection=automatic and 2Checkout bills every renewal itself: the period and renewal price travel in the signed link. WavePay extends access by exactly one period when the renewal notification arrives, ignores a resent notification, and never raises its own charge on top. A late renewal marks the subscription past due after three days and ends it after ten.

## Cancel, pause and change the price

Cancel now disables the subscription at 2Checkout; cancel at period end switches renewal off and keeps the paid access. Pause stops the next renewal until you resume it. Price changes what the next renewals cost. Each is applied at 2Checkout first, then recorded here.

## Refunds and chargebacks

POST /v2/internal/refunds refunds a completed order through 2Checkout's REST API, in part or in full, within three months. A refund issued in the 2Checkout dashboard arrives as a notification and is recorded once. A chargeback is recorded for you to see; it never silently refunds or revokes.

## Signed notifications

2Checkout posts IPN (orders, renewals, refunds, reversals, chargebacks) and LCN (subscription changes). Both are checked against an HMAC-SHA256 of the received values before anything happens, and answered with the signed receipt 2Checkout waits for. A notification for an order WavePay did not create is acknowledged and ignored.

## Test orders

Staging places 2Checkout links as test orders: use card 4111111111111111 with any expiry and CVV, and choose the outcome by cardholder name (John Doe succeeds; Mona Doe fails for insufficient funds). A deployment that takes live orders ignores test-order notifications, so a dummy card can never grant a licence.

## Switching it on

The 2Checkout rail is a configuration switch, not a code change: a deployment lists twocheckout in its enabled providers once the account is approved, and GET /v2/providers then offers it to buyers.

Source: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/guide-buy-now-pay-later.html

# Buy now, pay later for software: deposits and instalments on…

> WavePay BNPL takes a deposit at checkout and collects the rest from the customer's card on a schedule, retrying with a back-off until the full price is paid; it is…

HOW IT WORKS

# Buy now, pay later for software: deposits and instalments on cards

WavePay BNPL takes a deposit at checkout and collects the rest from the customer's card on a schedule, retrying with a back-off until the full price is paid; it is limited to non-prepaid cards, and WavePay collects but does not lend.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## How a plan runs

POST /v2/internal/bnpl with the number of instalments. The customer pays the deposit and their card is saved. Each interval the next instalment is charged; the last one is only what remains. When paid equals the price the plan completes and stops charging.

## Collection never gives up

A failed instalment is retried after one day, then two, then every three days, with no limit on attempts, until the total is collected or the merchant cancels the plan.

## Which cards

Cards only: provider paynow (Visa, Mastercard, ZimSwitch) or paypal (a vaulted card). Prepaid cards and virtual cards, including mobile-money virtual cards, are refused because they can be emptied or closed after delivery. A card is refused if the issuer reports it prepaid, if its first six digits fall in a range the operator has blocked, or if it cannot be screened at all.

## A refused card

The plan is cancelled and access withdrawn. The deposit is refunded automatically where the provider has a refund API (PayPal); for Paynow, which documents none, the plan's audit record is marked needsRefund so the merchant returns it.

## Access while overdue

Access is suspended after the grace period of missed payments (14 days by default) and restored by the next successful payment. Instalments settle money; they do not extend the access the deposit granted.

## Who carries the risk

The merchant. WavePay is a collection schedule, not a lender: it does not advance the merchant the balance. A card that stops working leaves the instalments unpaid, which is why access follows payment. Confirm that selling on instalments is permitted for your business and customers before you offer it.

## Keep going

- [2Checkout (Verifone) with WavePay: checkout, subscriptions, refunds and notifications](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/guide-2checkout.html)
- [API reference](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)
- [FAQ](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/faq.html)

Source: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/guide-idempotent-checkouts.html

> Send a stable Idempotency-Key with every POST /v2/checkouts — derived from your order id, not generated per attempt — and a retry after a timeout returns the original…

HOW IT WORKS

# Idempotent checkouts: why a retry should never charge twice

Send a stable Idempotency-Key with every POST /v2/checkouts — derived from your order id, not generated per attempt — and a retry after a timeout returns the original checkout instead of creating a second charge.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## The failure it prevents

A request times out and the client cannot tell whether the checkout was created. Without a key the safe-looking retry creates a second checkout and can charge the buyer twice.

## Choosing the key

Use something stable per order, such as order-1001. A random value per attempt defeats the point: each retry would look like a new request.

## Where it applies

Every checkout, hosted or wallet push. Settlement polling and webhooks are reads and need no key.

## Reconciling

Match on the checkout reference (pay_…) that comes back; the ledger holds one row per settlement.

- [2Checkout (Verifone) with WavePay: checkout, subscriptions, refunds and notifications](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/guide-2checkout.html)
- [API reference](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)
