Source: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/guide-offline-licence-verification.html

> WavePay signs each licence entitlement with an Ed25519 private key it never shares, so your app verifies the signature offline against the public key at GET…

HOW IT WORKS

# How offline licence verification works with Ed25519 entitlements

WavePay signs each licence entitlement with an Ed25519 private key it never shares, so your app verifies the signature offline against the public key at GET /v2/licensing/public-key and never needs to call a server to know a licence is genuine.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## The flow

A paid checkout emails a licence key. The device calls POST /v2/licensing/activate with the key and a deviceId and receives a signed entitlement. The app stores it and checks the signature locally.

## Why Ed25519

Verification needs only the public key, which is safe to embed in the app. Forging an entitlement requires the private key, which stays with the issuer.

## What this buys you

An app that works offline, no per-launch licence call to fail, and a trust root you can pin. When a customer loses a key, POST /v2/licensing/recover mails a fresh one.

## What it does not do

An offline check cannot know a licence was revoked after the entitlement was issued; design entitlement lifetimes to match how quickly you need revocation to bite.

- [2Checkout (Verifone) with WavePay: checkout, subscriptions, refunds and notifications](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/guide-2checkout.html)

# Recurring payments in Zimbabwe: what charges automatically and…

> A card token or a PayPal subscription can be charged every period with nobody present, but mobile wallets such as EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks and O'mari cannot be…

HOW IT WORKS

# Recurring payments in Zimbabwe: what charges automatically and what cannot

A card token or a PayPal subscription can be charged every period with nobody present, but mobile wallets such as EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks and O'mari cannot be debited unattended, so a WavePay subscription on a wallet sends the customer a fresh payment prompt each period and access follows what they pay.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## Two collection modes

automatic charges a saved instrument: a Paynow card token (Visa, Mastercard or ZimSwitch) or a PayPal subscription. invoice_and_remind raises a normal checkout each period, pushes the wallet prompt or sends a link, and extends access when it is paid. It is the only mode that works on every local rail.

## Why wallets are different

Paynow documents tokens for cards only. A wallet payment needs the customer's PIN every time, so no service can charge it silently. WavePay does not pretend otherwise: it asks each period.

## Paynow card tokens need Paynow's approval

A merchant may only tokenise cards once Paynow has enabled it for the integration. If a subscription asks for automatic collection and no token comes back, it falls back to invoice_and_remind and records why, instead of failing.

## Failed payments

A failed charge is retried the next day, then two days later. Three failures make the subscription past due, and a week after the first failed attempt it ends. A card whose token has expired is replaced by a payment request, and the customer is told.

## Cancelling

POST /v2/internal/subscriptions/cancel ends it now, or with atPeriodEnd true keeps access to the end of the paid period. A PayPal subscription is also cancelled at PayPal.

## Idempotent

Creating a subscription needs an Idempotency-Key, and every renewal is keyed by its period and attempt, so a repeated billing run can never charge a period twice.

- [2Checkout (Verifone) with WavePay: checkout, subscriptions, refunds and notifications](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/guide-2checkout.html)
- [API reference](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)
- [FAQ](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/faq.html)

# Testing WavePay with fake money: test keys, simulated outcomes…

> POST /v2/register returns a live key and a test key (mk_test_…); the test key calls the same routes but settles through a simulator that never contacts a payment…

HOW IT WORKS

# Testing WavePay with fake money: test keys, simulated outcomes and time travel

POST /v2/register returns a live key and a test key (mk_test_…); the test key calls the same routes but settles through a simulator that never contacts a payment provider, so you can drive every outcome of your integration, including renewals and instalments, without moving money.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## Getting a test key

Registration returns key (mk_live_…) and testKey (mk_test_…) together, both shown once. Send either in the x-wavepay-service-key header. A test key never counts against your plan's payment cap.

## Choosing the outcome

Use Paynow's own test phone numbers: 0771111111 pays, 0772222222 pays after ten seconds, 0773333333 is cancelled by the customer, 0774444444 fails for insufficient balance. Without a phone, tag the email: buyer+decline@example.com fails, +cancel cancels, +delay pays after ten seconds. For card tokens, +prepaid returns a prepaid card (BNPL refuses it) and +tokdecline returns a token whose later charges are declined.

## Hosted pages

A test checkout's checkoutUrl is a WavePay page with Approve and Decline buttons, so the redirect-and-return leg of your integration can be walked end to end. It only ever acts on test payments.

## Time travel

POST /v2/test/billing/run with {"advanceDays": 31} runs the billing engine as if 31 days had passed, once for your test subscriptions and instalment plans only. Run it again to reconcile the charges it raised.

## Features that are not yet live

Subscriptions, BNPL, refunds and card tokens are switched on per deployment. A test key can use every one of them regardless, which is how you build against them before they are enabled for live money. GET /v2/features reports the live state.

## What a test key does not prove

A simulator proves your integration handles every outcome; it does not prove a provider's behaviour. Run one live payment of the smallest amount before launch.

## चेकआउट आसान हिस्सा है। बाकी सब WavePay है।

### होस्टेड चेकआउट और वॉलेट पुश

खरीदारों को होस्टेड पेज पर भेजें, या EcoCash अनुरोध सीधे उनके फ़ोन पर भेजें।

### लाइसेंसिंग अंतर्निहित

हस्ताक्षरित अधिकार, ईमेल से लाइसेंस कुंजी, डिवाइस सक्रियण और पुनर्प्राप्ति। आपका ऐप ऑफ़लाइन सत्यापित करता है।

### सदस्यता और किस्तें

आवर्ती योजनाएँ, कार्ड पर अभी खरीदें बाद में भुगतान करें, और पहुँच समाप्त होने से पहले स्पष्ट विलंब अवधि।

### रिफ़ंड और उलटाव

प्रदाता के माध्यम से पूर्ण और आंशिक रिफ़ंड, किसने और क्यों किया इसके रिकॉर्ड के साथ।

### असली परीक्षण वातावरण

आपकी लाइव कुंजी के साथ एक परीक्षण कुंजी, एक सिम्युलेटर, और नवीनीकरण होते देखने के लिए समय यात्रा।

### एजेंटों के लिए बना

skill.md, OpenAPI, एक MCP सर्वर और WebMCP टूल, ताकि AI आपके लिए चेकआउट सेट कर सके।

### निपटान

डेवलपरों के लिए

## curl से शुरू करें। लाइसेंस कुंजी पर खत्म करें।

दस्तावेज़ का हर उदाहरण पहले परीक्षण कुंजी के साथ सैंडबॉक्स में चलता है, ताकि आप सुरक्षित रूप से प्रयोग कर सकें।

[API संदर्भ खोलें](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)

curl MCP JavaScript

```
# 1. register: a live key and a test key, shown once 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/register \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My App","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'

# 2. sell: returns a hosted checkout URL 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_test_… ' \
  -H 'idempotency-key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"my-app","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

```
# any MCP client: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/mcp 
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "wavepay_checkout",
    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
                   "provider": "paynow", "email": "buyer@example.com" } } }

# tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing,
#        wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_subscribe … 
```

```
const res = await fetch("https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "x-wavepay-service-key": process.env.WAVEPAY_KEY,
    "idempotency-key": crypto.randomUUID(),
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ productId: "my-app", planId: "pro",
                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
});
const { checkoutUrl, reference } = await res.json();
```

प्रश्न

## आपके पूछने से पहले उत्तर

मैं कौन से भुगतान माध्यम स्वीकार कर सकता हूँ?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through Paynow; Visa, Mastercard and PayPal; and crypto on eleven rails (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron, USDT, USDC). 2Checkout is built and switches on when the provider approves our account.

क्या आप मेरी बिक्री का प्रतिशत लेते हैं?

Only after your plan's included payments, and the percentage falls as your volume grows (from 2% down to 0.4%, with a small minimum per payment). Provider fees are paid to the provider at cost with no WavePay markup.

क्या मैं असली पैसे के बिना परीक्षण कर सकता हूँ?

हाँ। पंजीकरण पर आपको सिम्युलेटर वाली परीक्षण कुंजी मिलती है। वह कभी किसी प्रदाता तक नहीं पहुँचती और आपकी योजना में नहीं गिनी जाती।

खरीदारों को लाइसेंस कैसे मिलता है?

भुगतान निपटते ही WavePay लाइसेंस कुंजी ईमेल करता है, और आपका ऐप हस्ताक्षरित अधिकार को ऑफ़लाइन सत्यापित कर सकता है।

क्या कोई AI एजेंट WavePay इस्तेमाल कर सकता है?

हाँ। उसे skill.md, OpenAPI दस्तावेज़ या MCP सर्वर की ओर इंगित करें। एजेंट बिना ब्राउज़र के पंजीकरण, मूल्य निर्धारण, चेकआउट और मिलान कर सकता है।

# WavePay — pembayaran dan lisensi untuk perangkat lunak

> Terima EcoCash, kartu, dan PayPal dengan satu API. Daftar dalam satu permintaan, uji dengan uang palsu, lalu aktifkan lisensi, langganan, dan pengembalian dana.

Now with crypto, subscriptions and your own PayPal account

# Dapatkan bayaran untuk perangkat lunak Anda lewat *setiap metode yang dimiliki pembeli Anda*

Satu API untuk EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, ZimSwitch, kartu, dan PayPal. Daftar dalam satu permintaan, uji dengan uang palsu, lalu aktifkan dengan lisensi, langganan, dan pengembalian dana bawaan.

[Mulai gratis](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.html#register) [Baca dokumentasi](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html) [Untuk agen](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md)

- Paket gratis, tanpa kartu
- A fee that falls as you grow
- REST dan MCP

**20**payment methods

Metode pembayaran

## Setiap metode yang mungkin dimiliki pembeli

Zimbabwean wallets, cards, PayPal and eleven crypto rails. The providers endpoint always says what is live today.

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal Bitcoin Ethereum Solana BNB Litecoin Dogecoin Tron USDT USDC 2Checkout · segera hadir

Yang Anda dapatkan

## Checkout adalah bagian yang mudah. WavePay mengurus sisanya.

### Checkout terhosting dan dorongan dompet

Arahkan pembeli ke halaman terhosting, atau kirim permintaan EcoCash langsung ke ponsel mereka.

### Lisensi bawaan

Hak bertanda tangan, kunci lisensi lewat email, aktivasi perangkat, dan pemulihan. Aplikasi Anda memverifikasi secara luring.

### Langganan dan cicilan

Paket berulang, beli sekarang bayar nanti dengan kartu, dan masa tunggakan yang jelas sebelum akses berakhir.

### Pengembalian dana dan pembatalan

Pengembalian penuh dan sebagian lewat penyedia, dengan catatan siapa yang melakukannya dan mengapa.

### Lingkungan uji yang nyata

Kunci uji di samping kunci langsung, simulator, dan perjalanan waktu untuk melihat perpanjangan terjadi.

### Dibuat untuk agen

skill.md, OpenAPI, server MCP, dan alat WebMCP, sehingga AI dapat menyiapkan checkout untuk Anda.

Cara kerjanya

## Tiga permintaan dari nol hingga terbayar

1

### Daftar

Satu permintaan mengembalikan kunci langsung dan kunci uji. Paket gratis, langsung aktif.

2

### Jual

Buat checkout dan dapatkan URL terhosting, atau kirim permintaan dompet ke ponsel.

3

### Selesaikan

Webhook bertanda tangan atau polling mengonfirmasi uang masuk. Kunci lisensi dikirim otomatis lewat email.

Untuk pengembang

## Mulai dengan curl. Akhiri dengan kunci lisensi.

Setiap contoh dalam dokumentasi dijalankan lebih dulu di sandbox dengan kunci uji, sehingga Anda bisa mencoba dengan aman.

[Buka referensi API](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)

curl MCP JavaScript

```
# 1. register: a live key and a test key, shown once 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/register \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My App","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'

# 2. sell: returns a hosted checkout URL 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_test_… ' \
  -H 'idempotency-key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"my-app","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

```
# any MCP client: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/mcp 
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "wavepay_checkout",
    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
                   "provider": "paynow", "email": "buyer@example.com" } } }

# tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing,
#        wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_subscribe … 
```

```
const res = await fetch("https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "x-wavepay-service-key": process.env.WAVEPAY_KEY,
    "idempotency-key": crypto.randomUUID(),
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ productId: "my-app", planId: "pro",
                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
});
const { checkoutUrl, reference } = await res.json();
```

Pertanyaan

## Jawaban sebelum Anda bertanya

Metode pembayaran apa yang bisa saya terima?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through Paynow; Visa, Mastercard and PayPal; and crypto on eleven rails (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron, USDT, USDC). 2Checkout is built and switches on when the provider approves our account.

Apakah Anda mengambil persentase dari penjualan saya?

Only after your plan's included payments, and the percentage falls as your volume grows (from 2% down to 0.4%, with a small minimum per payment). Provider fees are paid to the provider at cost with no WavePay markup.

Bisakah saya menguji tanpa uang sungguhan?

Bisa. Pendaftaran memberi Anda kunci uji yang memakai simulator. Kunci itu tidak pernah menjangkau penyedia dan tidak dihitung dalam paket Anda.

Bagaimana pembeli mendapatkan lisensinya?

Saat pembayaran selesai, WavePay mengirim kunci lisensi lewat email, dan aplikasi Anda dapat memverifikasi hak bertanda tangan secara luring.

Bisakah agen AI menggunakan WavePay?

Bisa. Arahkan ke skill.md, dokumen OpenAPI, atau server MCP. Agen dapat mendaftar, menentukan harga, melakukan checkout, dan merekonsiliasi tanpa peramban.

# WavePay — checkout and licensing for software

> Take EcoCash, cards and PayPal with one API. Register in one request, test with fake money, then go live with licence keys, subscriptions and refunds.

Now with crypto, subscriptions and your own PayPal account

# Get paid for your software on *every rail your buyers hold*

One API for EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, ZimSwitch, cards and PayPal. Register in one request, test with fake money, and go live with licence keys, subscriptions and refunds built in.

[Start free](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.html#register) [Read the docs](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html) [For agents](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md)

- Free plan, no card needed
- A fee that falls as you grow
- REST and MCP

**20**payment methods

**25**free payments a month

**2%→0.4%**usage fee, falling with volume

**15**languages

Payment rails

## Every rail a buyer might hold

Zimbabwean wallets, cards, PayPal and eleven crypto rails. The providers endpoint always says what is live today.

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal Bitcoin Ethereum Solana BNB Litecoin Dogecoin Tron USDT USDC 2Checkout · coming soon

What you get

## Checkout is the easy part. WavePay is the rest of it.

### Hosted checkout and wallet push

Send buyers to a hosted page, or push an EcoCash prompt straight to their phone.

### Licensing built in

Signed entitlements, licence keys by email, device activation and recovery. Your app verifies offline.

### Subscriptions and instalments

Recurring plans, buy now pay later on cards, and a clear past-due period before access ends.

### Refunds and reversals

Full and partial refunds through the provider, with who did it and why on record.

### A real test environment

A test key beside your live key, a simulator, and time travel to watch a renewal happen.

### Built for agents

skill.md, OpenAPI, an MCP server and WebMCP tools, so an AI can set up checkout for you.

How it works

## Three requests from nothing to paid

1

### Register

One request returns a live key and a test key. Free plan, working immediately.

2

### Sell

Create a checkout and get a hosted URL, or push a wallet prompt to a phone.

3

### Settle

A signed webhook or a poll confirms the money. The licence key is emailed automatically.

For developers

## Start with curl. Finish with a licence key.

Every example in the documentation runs against the sandbox with a test key first, so you can break things safely.

[Open the API reference](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)

  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My App","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'

# 2. sell: returns a hosted checkout URL

  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_test_… ' \
  -H 'idempotency-key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"my-app","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

```
# any MCP client: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/mcp

  "params": {
    "name": "wavepay_checkout",
    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
                   "provider": "paynow", "email": "buyer@example.com" } } }

# tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing,
#        wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_subscribe … 
```

```

Questions

## Answers before you ask

Which payment methods can I accept?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through Paynow; Visa, Mastercard and PayPal; and crypto on eleven rails (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron, USDT, USDC). 2Checkout is built and switches on when the provider approves our account.

Do you take a percentage of my sales?

Only after your plan's included payments, and the percentage falls as your volume grows (from 2% down to 0.4%, with a small minimum per payment). Provider fees are paid to the provider at cost with no WavePay markup.

Can I test without real money?

Yes. Registration gives you a test key that uses a simulator. It never reaches a provider and never counts against your plan.

How do buyers get their licence?

When a payment settles, WavePay emails a licence key, and your app can verify the signed entitlement offline.

Can an AI agent use WavePay?

Yes. Point it at skill.md, the OpenAPI document or the MCP server. An agent can register, price, check out and reconcile without a browser.

# Integrate WavePay from Claude Code, OpenClaw, OpenFang or a…

> Any MCP client can use WavePay by adding the endpoint https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/mcp; Claude Code adds it with one command, and a plain API…

USE CASE

# Integrate WavePay from Claude Code, OpenClaw, OpenFang or a plain API client

Any MCP client can use WavePay by adding the endpoint https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/mcp; Claude Code adds it with one command, and a plain API client needs only POST /v2/register and POST /v2/checkouts.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## The flow

1. Claude Code: claude mcp add --transport http wavepay https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/mcp
2. OpenClaw, OpenFang and other MCP clients: register the same streamable-HTTP endpoint, https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/mcp, in the client's MCP server settings.
3. Plain HTTP: curl -sX POST https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/register -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"name":"My app","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'
4. Then test: use the mk_test_ key from the response to create a checkout with fake money, and read the result from GET /v2/checkouts/<reference>/status.

## Questions

## Do I need an account first?

No. POST /v2/register creates the merchant and returns both keys.

## Is there a test mode?

Yes: the mk_test_ key uses the same routes and settles through a simulator.

# WavePay — pagamenti e licenze per il software

> Accetta EcoCash, carte e PayPal con una sola API. Registrati in una richiesta, prova con denaro finto e vai in produzione con licenze, abbonamenti e rimborsi.

Now with crypto, subscriptions and your own PayPal account

# Fatti pagare il tuo software su *ogni metodo che i tuoi clienti usano*

Una sola API per EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, ZimSwitch, carte e PayPal. Registrati in una richiesta, prova con denaro finto e vai live con licenze, abbonamenti e rimborsi già inclusi.

[Inizia gratis](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.html#register) [Leggi la documentazione](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html) [Per gli agenti](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md)

Metodi di pagamento

## Ogni metodo che un acquirente può avere

Zimbabwean wallets, cards, PayPal and eleven crypto rails. The providers endpoint always says what is live today.

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal Bitcoin Ethereum Solana BNB Litecoin Dogecoin Tron USDT USDC 2Checkout · in arrivo

Cosa ottieni

## Il checkout è la parte facile. WavePay è tutto il resto.

### Checkout ospitato e richiesta al portafoglio

Manda gli acquirenti a una pagina ospitata, oppure invia una richiesta EcoCash direttamente al loro telefono.

### Licenze integrate

Diritti firmati, chiavi di licenza via e-mail, attivazione dei dispositivi e recupero. La tua app verifica offline.

### Abbonamenti e rate

Piani ricorrenti, paga dopo con carta e un periodo di ritardo chiaro prima che l'accesso termini.

### Rimborsi e storni

Rimborsi totali e parziali tramite il fornitore, con traccia di chi li ha fatti e perché.

### Un vero ambiente di prova

Una chiave di prova accanto a quella live, un simulatore e un viaggio nel tempo per vedere un rinnovo.

### Pensato per gli agenti

skill.md, OpenAPI, un server MCP e strumenti WebMCP: un'IA può configurare il checkout per te.

Come funziona

## Tre richieste da zero a pagato

1

### Registrati

Una richiesta restituisce una chiave live e una di prova. Piano gratuito, attivo subito.

2

### Vendi

Crea un checkout e ottieni un URL ospitato, oppure invia una richiesta a un telefono.

3

### Incassa

Un webhook firmato o un controllo conferma il denaro. La chiave di licenza arriva via e-mail in automatico.

Domande

## Risposte prima che tu chieda

Quali metodi di pagamento posso accettare?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through Paynow; Visa, Mastercard and PayPal; and crypto on eleven rails (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron, USDT, USDC). 2Checkout is built and switches on when the provider approves our account.

Prendete una percentuale sulle mie vendite?

Only after your plan's included payments, and the percentage falls as your volume grows (from 2% down to 0.4%, with a small minimum per payment). Provider fees are paid to the provider at cost with no WavePay markup.

Posso provare senza denaro reale?

Sì. La registrazione ti dà una chiave di prova che usa un simulatore. Non raggiunge mai un fornitore e non conta nel tuo piano.

Come ricevono la licenza gli acquirenti?

Quando un pagamento è regolato, WavePay invia una chiave di licenza via e-mail e la tua app può verificare offline il diritto firmato.

Un agente IA può usare WavePay?

Sì. Indicagli skill.md, il documento OpenAPI o il server MCP. Un agente può registrarsi, fissare i prezzi, incassare e riconciliare senza browser.

# WavePay — ソフトウェアの決済とライセンス

> 1つのAPIでEcoCash、カード、PayPalに対応。1回のリクエストで登録し、擬似資金でテストして、ライセンス・定期課金・返金とともに本番へ。

Now with crypto, subscriptions and your own PayPal account

# あなたのソフトウェアの代金を *購入者が持つあらゆる決済手段で受け取る*

EcoCash、OneMoney、InnBucks、ZimSwitch、カード、PayPalを1つのAPIで。1回のリクエストで登録し、擬似資金でテストし、ライセンス・定期課金・返金が組み込まれた状態で本番へ。

[無料で始める](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.html#register) [ドキュメントを読む](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html) [エージェント向け](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md)

- 無料プラン、カード不要
- A fee that falls as you grow
- RESTとMCP

**20**payment methods

**25**毎月の無料決済数

**2%→0.4%**usage fee, falling with volume

**15**言語

決済手段

## 購入者が持ちうるあらゆる手段に対応

Zimbabwean wallets, cards, PayPal and eleven crypto rails. The providers endpoint always says what is live today.

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal Bitcoin Ethereum Solana BNB Litecoin Dogecoin Tron USDT USDC 2Checkout · 近日対応

できること

## 決済は簡単な部分です。残りはWavePayが担います。

### ホスト型チェックアウトとウォレット請求

購入者をホスト型ページへ誘導するか、EcoCashの請求を直接スマートフォンへ送信します。

### ライセンス管理を内蔵

署名付き権利、メールでのライセンスキー送付、デバイス認証と復旧。アプリはオフラインで検証できます。

### 定期課金と分割払い

継続課金プラン、カードでの後払い、アクセス終了前の明確な猶予期間。

### 返金と取消

プロバイダー経由で全額・一部返金を行い、誰がなぜ実施したかを記録します。

### 本物のテスト環境

本番キーの隣にテストキー、シミュレーター、そして更新を確認できるタイムトラベル機能。

### エージェント向けに設計

skill.md、OpenAPI、MCPサーバー、WebMCPツールにより、AIがチェックアウトを設定できます。

仕組み

## 3回のリクエストで、ゼロから入金まで

1

### 登録

1回のリクエストで本番キーとテストキーが返ります。無料プランですぐに利用できます。

2

### 販売

チェックアウトを作成してホスト型URLを取得するか、スマートフォンへウォレット請求を送ります。

3

### 精算

署名付きWebhookまたはポーリングで入金を確認し、ライセンスキーは自動でメール送信されます。

開発者向け

## curlで始めて、ライセンスキーで終える。

ドキュメントのすべての例は、まずテストキーを使ってサンドボックスで動作するため、安心して試せます。

[APIリファレンスを開く](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)

curl MCP JavaScript

```
# 1. register: a live key and a test key, shown once 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/register \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My App","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'

# 2. sell: returns a hosted checkout URL 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_test_… ' \
  -H 'idempotency-key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"my-app","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

```
# any MCP client: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/mcp 
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "wavepay_checkout",
    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
                   "provider": "paynow", "email": "buyer@example.com" } } }

# tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing,
#        wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_subscribe … 
```

```
const res = await fetch("https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "x-wavepay-service-key": process.env.WAVEPAY_KEY,
    "idempotency-key": crypto.randomUUID(),
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ productId: "my-app", planId: "pro",
                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
});
const { checkoutUrl, reference } = await res.json();
```

よくある質問

## 聞かれる前にお答えします

どの決済手段を受け付けられますか？

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through Paynow; Visa, Mastercard and PayPal; and crypto on eleven rails (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron, USDT, USDC). 2Checkout is built and switches on when the provider approves our account.

売上の何パーセントかを受け取りますか？

Only after your plan's included payments, and the percentage falls as your volume grows (from 2% down to 0.4%, with a small minimum per payment). Provider fees are paid to the provider at cost with no WavePay markup.

本物のお金なしでテストできますか？

はい。登録するとシミュレーターを使うテストキーが発行されます。プロバイダーには届かず、プランの件数にも数えられません。

購入者はどうやってライセンスを受け取りますか？

決済が完了すると、WavePayがライセンスキーをメールで送信し、アプリは署名付き権利をオフラインで検証できます。

AIエージェントはWavePayを使えますか？

はい。skill.md、OpenAPIドキュメント、MCPサーバーを案内してください。エージェントはブラウザなしで登録、価格設定、決済、照合ができます。

# Multi-currency payment gateway: cards, PayPal and crypto behind…

> WavePay is a multi-currency payment gateway API: Visa and Mastercard and PayPal for international buyers, Paynow for Zimbabwean wallets in US dollars, and eleven…

USE CASE

# Multi-currency payment gateway: cards, PayPal and crypto behind one API

WavePay is a multi-currency payment gateway API: Visa and Mastercard and PayPal for international buyers, Paynow for Zimbabwean wallets in US dollars, and eleven crypto rails quoted in US dollars, all through one checkout call and one ledger.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## The flow

1. Visa and Mastercard payment integration: the hosted checkout takes cards through PayPal and Paynow without your servers touching a card number.
2. PayPal integration API: PayPal orders are created and captured for you; a merchant can connect their own PayPal account so the money lands with them.
3. Crypto: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron, USDT and USDC, quoted in US dollars at a rate at most ten minutes old.
4. One ledger and one webhook format whichever rail the buyer chose.

## Questions

## Does the money go to me or to WavePay?

With own keys you connect your own PayPal account and PayPal pays you directly; WavePay never holds it. A mode where WavePay collects and pays out needs a payment service provider licence and is not offered yet.

## Which currencies are supported?

PayPal takes the currencies your PayPal account supports; Paynow and crypto are quoted in US dollars. GET /v2/providers lists what is live.

# WavePay — inkokhelo lamalayisense ezinhlelo

> Samukela i-EcoCash, amakhadi le-PayPal nge-API eyodwa. Bhalisa ngesicelo esisodwa, linga ngemali yokulingisa, uqale ngamalayisense lokubuyisela imali.

Now with crypto, subscriptions and your own PayPal account

# Khokhelwa izinhlelo zakho nge *yonke indlela abathengi bakho abayisebenzisayo*

I-API eyodwa ye-EcoCash, i-OneMoney, i-InnBucks, i-ZimSwitch, amakhadi le-PayPal. Bhalisa ngesicelo esisodwa, linga ngemali yokulingisa, bese uqala ngamalayisense, ukukhokha ngezikhathi lokubuyisela imali okufakiwe.

[Qala mahala](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.html#register) [Funda imibhalo](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html) [Kuma-ejenti](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md)

Izindlela zokukhokha

## Zonke izindlela umthengi angaba lazo

Zimbabwean wallets, cards, PayPal and eleven crypto rails. The providers endpoint always says what is live today.

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal Bitcoin Ethereum Solana BNB Litecoin Dogecoin Tron USDT USDC 2Checkout · kuyeza

Okuzakuthola

## Ukukhokha yikhona okulula. I-WavePay yikho konke okuseleyo.

### Ikhasi lokukhokha lesicelo sesikhwama

Thumela abathengi ekhasini lokukhokha, loba uthumele isicelo se-EcoCash ngqo efoyinini labo.

### Amalayisense akhelwe ngaphakathi

Amalungelo asayiniwe, okhiye bamalayisense nge-imeyili, ukusebenzisa amadivayisi lokubuyiselwa. I-app yakho iyahlola ingelayo i-inthanethi.

### Ukukhokha ngezikhathi langezigaba

Izinhlelo eziphindaphindwayo, thenga manje ukhokhe emva kwesikhathi ngekhadi, lesikhathi esicacileyo sokubambezela ukufinyelela kungakapheli.

### Ukubuyisela imali lokuhlehlisa

Ukubuyisela imali yonke loba ingxenye ngomhlinzeki, lerekhodi lokuthi ngubani owakwenzayo lesizatho.

### Indawo yangempela yokulinga

Ukhiye wokulinga eduze kokhiye wakho wangempela, i-simulator, lokuhamba kwesikhathi ukubona ukuvuselelwa.

### Yakhelwe ama-ejenti

I-skill.md, i-OpenAPI, iseva ye-MCP lamathuluzi e-WebMCP, ukuze i-AI ikulungisele ukukhokha.

Isebenza njani

## Izicelo ezintathu ukusuka kunalutho kuze kube khokhelwe

1

### Bhalisa

Isicelo esisodwa sibuyisa ukhiye wangempela lokhiye wokulinga. Uhlelo lwamahala, lusebenza ngokuphangisa.

2

### Thengisa

Dala ukukhokha uthole i-URL yekhasi, loba uthumele isicelo sesikhwama efoyinini.

3

### Qedisa

I-webhook esayiniwe loba ukubuzisisa kuqinisekisa imali. Ukhiye welayisense uthunyelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo nge-imeyili.

                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
});
const { checkoutUrl, reference } = await res.json();
```

Imibuzo

## Izimpendulo ungakabuzi

Ngingasamukela zimuphi izindlela zokukhokha?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through Paynow; Visa, Mastercard and PayPal; and crypto on eleven rails (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron, USDT, USDC). 2Checkout is built and switches on when the provider approves our account.

Niyathatha ipesenti yokuthengisa kwami yini?

Only after your plan's included payments, and the percentage falls as your volume grows (from 2% down to 0.4%, with a small minimum per payment). Provider fees are paid to the provider at cost with no WavePay markup.

Ngingalinga ngaphandle kwemali yangempela yini?

Yebo. Ukubhalisa kukunika ukhiye wokulinga osebenzisa i-simulator. Kawufinyeleli kumhlinzeki kawubalwa kuhlelo lwakho.

Abathengi bayitholaphi ilayisense yabo?

Lapho inkokhelo isiphelile, i-WavePay ithumela ukhiye welayisense nge-imeyili, ne-app yakho ingahlola ilungelo elisayiniweyo ingelayo i-inthanethi.

I-ejenti ye-AI ingasebenzisa i-WavePay yini?

Yebo. Yikhombise i-skill.md, imibhalo ye-OpenAPI loba iseva ye-MCP. I-ejenti ingabhalisa, ibeke intengo, ikhokhise iqathanise ingelayo isiphequluli.

USE CASE

# How to charge for API access

Charge for an API with WavePay by selling plans through checkout, issuing a licence key on payment, and gating requests on the key — settlement arrives by signed webhook so access can be granted automatically.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## The flow

1. Sell: a checkout per plan with POST /v2/checkouts.
2. Issue: the paid checkout emails the licence key; activation returns a signed entitlement.
3. Gate: your API checks the entitlement or key before serving a request.
4. Automate: register a webhook with POST /v2/internal/sites/webhook; the HMAC secret is returned once.

## Questions

## How does my API learn that someone paid?

Through a signed webhook, or by polling checkout status.

## Is the webhook authentic?

Settlements are signed with the HMAC secret returned when you registered the webhook.

USE CASE

# How to charge for an app or SaaS

Charge for an app or SaaS with WavePay by pricing plans as data, sending buyers to a hosted checkout, and unlocking seats from licence activations or your signed settlement webhook.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## The flow

1. Plans are data: GET /v2/pricing?productId=… returns plans, prices and promotions.
2. Promotions without a release: mint coupons with POST /v2/internal/coupons/mint (Basic and above).
3. Settle: signed webhooks, or drain the ledger with POST /v2/internal/payments.
4. Seats: activation codes and device quotas come from the licensing endpoints.

## Questions

## Can I run a sale without redeploying?

Yes. Pricing is data, so a promotion is a row, not a release.

## Where do I see every payment?

In the payments ledger — one feed for every rail, drained with since/limit cursors.

USE CASE

# How to charge for a bot

Charge for a bot with WavePay by pushing a wallet prompt to the user's phone with paynow-mobile, so the payment happens inside the chat flow without a browser, then unlock features when status reads collected.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## The flow

1. Collect the phone number in chat, then POST /v2/checkouts with paynow-mobile.
2. Poll GET /v2/checkouts/<reference>/status until collected, or use a webhook.
3. Unlock the user's features and store the reference for support.
4. Agents can do all of it through POST /mcp — wavepay_checkout and wavepay_checkout_status.

## Questions

## Can a bot take payment without a web page?

Yes, with paynow-mobile and the buyer's phone number.

## Can the bot's own agent run the integration?

Yes. The MCP tools expose registration, pricing, checkout and status.

> Sell a browser extension with WavePay by creating a checkout for your Pro plan, emailing a licence key on payment, and letting the extension verify an Ed25519-signed…

USE CASE

# How to charge for a browser extension

Sell a browser extension with WavePay by creating a checkout for your Pro plan, emailing a licence key on payment, and letting the extension verify an Ed25519-signed entitlement offline — T3rnel Browser sells Pro this way in production.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## The flow

1. Checkout: POST /v2/checkouts for the plan; the buyer pays with the rail they hold.
2. Licence: a paid checkout emails a licence key automatically.
3. Activation: POST /v2/licensing/activate with the key and a deviceId returns a signed entitlement.
4. Verification: the extension checks the entitlement offline against GET /v2/licensing/public-key — no call home on every launch.
5. Recovery: POST /v2/licensing/recover mails a lost key again.

## Questions

## Does my extension need a server to check licences?

No. Entitlements are Ed25519-signed, so the extension verifies them offline against the public key.

## Who already does this?

T3rnel Browser sells its Pro tier on this exact flow.

> In a game, charge a player without leaving the session by using provider paynow-mobile with their phone number — the EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks or O'mari prompt is…

USE CASE

# How to take payments in a game

In a game, charge a player without leaving the session by using provider paynow-mobile with their phone number — the EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks or O'mari prompt is pushed to their handset and your game polls checkout status until it reads collected.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## The flow

1. Create: POST /v2/checkouts with provider paynow-mobile and the player's phone (EcoCash, OneMoney or InnBucks).
2. Wait: poll GET /v2/checkouts/<reference>/status — pending, collected or expired.
3. Grant: unlock the item when the status reads collected, or on your signed webhook.
4. Retry safely: reuse the same Idempotency-Key so a network retry cannot charge twice.

## Questions

## Does the player need to open a web page?

No. With paynow-mobile the prompt arrives on their handset, for EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks and O'mari wallets.

## How do I avoid double-charging on a retry?

Send the same Idempotency-Key; the same checkout is returned.

# Pricing — WavePay

> WavePay pricing by payments processed: Free $0 for 25 payments a month, Basic $9 for 250, Pro $29 for 2,500. Every rail included, no percentage rake.

Merchant pricing

# A plan for the software, a small percentage for the volume

WavePay is the checkout, licensing and billing layer. You pay a plan for the software, and a percentage that **falls as your volume grows** once you pass your plan's included payments. Provider fees, bank charges and the transfer tax are paid to the provider at cost: WavePay adds no markup to them.

### Free

$0 forever

25 payments a month, test mode, one site. Stops at the cap; never charges.

- 25 payments / month included
- 1 site
- Signed webhooks + payments ledger

Register free — one POST

### Starter

$15 USD / month

100 payments included, three sites, coupons, webhooks.

- 100 payments / month included
- 3 sites
- Coupons & promotions
- Signed webhooks + payments ledger

Get Starter — $15/mo

Recommended

### Growth

$49 USD / month

500 payments included, ten sites, subscriptions and instalments.

- 500 payments / month included
- 10 sites
- Coupons & promotions
- Signed webhooks + payments ledger

Get Growth — $49/mo

### Scale

$149 USD / month

2,500 payments included, thirty sites, priority support.

- 2,500 payments / month included
- 30 sites
- Coupons & promotions
- Signed webhooks + payments ledger
- Priority support

Get Scale — $149/mo

### Enterprise

From $499 USD / month

From $499 a month: custom volume, SLA, onboarding. By quote.

- Custom volume
- Unlimited sites
- Coupons & promotions
- Signed webhooks + payments ledger
- Priority support and an SLA

[Talk to us](mailto:support@t3ratech.co.zw?subject=WavePay%20Enterprise)

### After your included payments

Each extra payment pays a percentage of its value, by its number in the month, with a minimum per payment. The rate only ever falls.

| Payment number in the month | Rate | Minimum per payment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1–1,000 | 2% | $0.10 |
| 1,001–2,500 | 1.5% | $0.08 |
| 2,501–10,000 | 1% | $0.06 |
| 10,001–50,000 | 0.6% | $0.05 |
| 50,001+ | 0.4% | $0.04 |

Example: Growth, 1,000 payments of $10 in a month = $49 plan + $100 usage = $149 ($0.149 per payment, 1.49% of sales). Billed monthly in arrears as one invoice; annual prepay is ten months for twelve. Prices exclude VAT where it applies. The same numbers, machine-readable: [pricing.json](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.json).

### Your money goes to you

With **own keys** (the default) you connect your own PayPal account and the provider pays you directly: WavePay never holds your money. Zimbabwean merchants use Paynow, EcoCash and crypto. A mode where WavePay collects and pays out needs a Reserve Bank payment-service-provider licence and is not offered yet.

### Start in one POST — no form, no call

```
# Register — returns your live merchant key once. Free tier, working now:
curl -sX POST https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/register \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My Product","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'
# → 201 { "merchantId": "mer_…", "key": "mk_live_…", "planId": "free", "paymentsPerMonth": 25 }

# Upgrade — a normal checkout on the wavepay product, your own rails:
curl -sX POST https://t3rnel-wavepay-production.t3ratech.workers.dev/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: upgrade-' \
  -d '{"productId":"wavepay","planId":"growth","provider":"paynow","email":"you@example.com"}'
# → 201 { "checkoutUrl": "https://www.paynow.co.zw/…", … } — settle it and
#   your merchant's plan_id moves to growth. provider "paypal" works too.
```

Agents: [skill.md](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md) is the same story in one markdown file, and `POST /mcp` exposes it all as tools. Registration returns a live key and a test key (`mk_test_…`) — the test key uses the same routes with fake money, never reaches a provider and never counts against the cap. Subscriptions, buy now pay later and refunds are usable in test mode today and switched on for live money per deployment (`GET /v2/features`). Questions: [support@t3ratech.co.zw](mailto:support@t3ratech.co.zw).

### Fair fine print

Free stops at its 25 payments and never charges. Paid plans never refuse a buyer at the allowance: later payments are charged by the schedule above. A cap or a charge never blocks or double-charges a buyer mid-payment. Check [status](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/status.html) for the live rails.

> What personal data WavePay processes, why, which processors we use, how long we keep it and how to exercise your rights under Zimbabwe's data protection law and the GDPR.

LEGAL

# Privacy policy

What personal data WavePay processes, why, which processors we use, how long we keep it and how to exercise your rights under Zimbabwe's data protection law and the GDPR.

Updated 2026-10-31 · TeraTech Solutions (Private) Limited

## Who we are

WavePay is operated by TeraTech Solutions (Private) Limited, Harare, Zimbabwe ("T3raTech", "we"). For merchants' buyers we are usually a processor acting for the merchant; for merchants and website visitors we are the controller. Contact: [support@t3ratech.co.zw](mailto:support@t3ratech.co.zw).

## What we process

- **Merchants:** name, owner email, keys (as hashes), connected provider account identifiers (credentials sealed), plan and usage.
- **Buyers:** email address and, for wallet prompts, phone number (encrypted, with keyed hashes for lookups), payment reference, amount, currency, status and the provider's reference.
- **Licence holders:** licence key activations and the device public key used to verify them.
- **Visitors:** page views and interactions through Google Analytics 4, a language and theme preference, and network address for rate limiting and abuse protection.

## What we never process

Card numbers, card security codes and bank passwords. They are entered on the provider's own page and never reach WavePay. We do not sell personal data and we do not build advertising profiles.

## Why we process it (lawful bases)

To run the service and your contract (settle payments, issue licences, send receipts); legitimate interests (security, fraud and abuse prevention, reconciliation, improving the service); legal obligations (financial records, tax); and consent where we ask for it (newsletters: every message carries one-click unsubscribe).

## Processors and recipients

- Cloudflare: hosting, network and database.
- Paynow, PayPal and Verifone (2Checkout): the payment providers you or the buyer choose.
- SendGrid: transactional and newsletter email.
- Binance: reading credited crypto deposits for T3raTech's own sales.
- Google Analytics and ShareThis: website analytics and share buttons (see [cookies](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/cookies.html)).
- GitHub Pages: hosting of part of this website.

Each processes data only for the purpose above and under its own terms.

## International transfers

Our processors operate worldwide, so data may be processed outside Zimbabwe. We rely on the safeguards each processor offers and on the data protection law that applies to you.

## Retention

We keep payment and ledger records for as long as financial record-keeping requires, buyer contact data only as long as it is needed to settle, support and receipt a payment, and operational logs for a short period. Ask us to delete what the law does not require us to keep.

## Your rights

Under the Cyber and Data Protection Act 2021 of Zimbabwe, and under the GDPR where it applies, you may ask for access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability and to object, and to complain to the supervisory authority (in Zimbabwe, POTRAZ). Write to [support@t3ratech.co.zw](mailto:support@t3ratech.co.zw); we answer within one month. Buyers: your merchant decides why your data is collected, so we will also pass your request to them.

## Children and changes

WavePay is for businesses and is not directed at children. We will post changes here with a new date; material changes are also emailed to merchants.

# WavePay — pagamentos e licenças para software

> Aceite EcoCash, cartões e PayPal com uma só API. Registe-se num pedido, teste com dinheiro fictício e passe para produção com licenças, subscrições e reembolsos.

Now with crypto, subscriptions and your own PayPal account

# Seja pago pelo seu software em *todos os meios que os seus clientes usam*

Uma API para EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, ZimSwitch, cartões e PayPal. Registe-se num pedido, teste com dinheiro fictício e passe para produção com licenças, subscrições e reembolsos incluídos.

[Começar grátis](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.html#register) [Ler a documentação](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html) [Para agentes](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md)

- Plano gratuito, sem cartão
- A fee that falls as you grow
- REST e MCP

**20**payment methods

**25**pagamentos gratuitos por mês

**2%→0.4%**usage fee, falling with volume

**15**idiomas

Meios de pagamento

## Todos os meios que um cliente pode ter

Zimbabwean wallets, cards, PayPal and eleven crypto rails. The providers endpoint always says what is live today.

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal Bitcoin Ethereum Solana BNB Litecoin Dogecoin Tron USDT USDC 2Checkout · em breve

O que recebe

## O checkout é a parte fácil. A WavePay trata do resto.

### Checkout alojado e pedido na carteira

Envie os clientes para uma página alojada ou envie um pedido EcoCash diretamente para o telemóvel.

### Licenciamento integrado

Direitos assinados, chaves de licença por e-mail, ativação de dispositivos e recuperação. A sua aplicação verifica offline.

### Subscrições e prestações

Planos recorrentes, compre agora e pague depois com cartão, e um prazo claro de atraso antes de terminar o acesso.

### Reembolsos e estornos

Reembolsos totais ou parciais através do fornecedor, com registo de quem os fez e porquê.

### Um ambiente de teste real

Uma chave de teste ao lado da chave de produção, um simulador e viagem no tempo para ver uma renovação acontecer.

### Feito para agentes

skill.md, OpenAPI, um servidor MCP e ferramentas WebMCP: uma IA pode configurar o checkout por si.

Como funciona

## Três pedidos do zero ao pagamento

1

### Registar

Um pedido devolve uma chave de produção e uma chave de teste. Plano gratuito, ativo de imediato.

2

### Vender

Crie um checkout e obtenha um URL alojado, ou envie um pedido para um telemóvel.

3

### Liquidar

Um webhook assinado ou uma consulta confirma o dinheiro. A chave de licença é enviada automaticamente.

Para programadores

## Comece com curl. Termine com uma chave de licença.

Todos os exemplos da documentação correm primeiro no ambiente de testes com uma chave de teste, para poder errar em segurança.

[Abrir a referência da API](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)

curl MCP JavaScript

```
# 1. register: a live key and a test key, shown once 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/register \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My App","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'

# 2. sell: returns a hosted checkout URL 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_test_… ' \
  -H 'idempotency-key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"my-app","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

```
# any MCP client: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/mcp 
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "wavepay_checkout",
    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
                   "provider": "paynow", "email": "buyer@example.com" } } }

# tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing,
#        wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_subscribe … 
```

```
const res = await fetch("https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "x-wavepay-service-key": process.env.WAVEPAY_KEY,
    "idempotency-key": crypto.randomUUID(),
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ productId: "my-app", planId: "pro",
                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
});
const { checkoutUrl, reference } = await res.json();
```

Perguntas

## Respostas antes de perguntar

Que meios de pagamento posso aceitar?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through Paynow; Visa, Mastercard and PayPal; and crypto on eleven rails (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron, USDT, USDC). 2Checkout is built and switches on when the provider approves our account.

Cobram uma percentagem das minhas vendas?

Only after your plan's included payments, and the percentage falls as your volume grows (from 2% down to 0.4%, with a small minimum per payment). Provider fees are paid to the provider at cost with no WavePay markup.

Posso testar sem dinheiro real?

Sim. O registo dá-lhe uma chave de teste que usa um simulador. Nunca chega a um fornecedor e não conta para o seu plano.

Como recebem os compradores a licença?

Quando um pagamento é liquidado, a WavePay envia uma chave de licença por e-mail e a sua aplicação pode verificar offline o direito assinado.

Um agente de IA pode usar a WavePay?

Sim. Indique-lhe o skill.md, o documento OpenAPI ou o servidor MCP. Um agente pode registar-se, definir preços, cobrar e reconciliar sem navegador.

Что вы получаете

## Оплата — самая простая часть. Остальное — WavePay.

### Страница оплаты и запрос в кошелёк

Отправляйте покупателей на страницу оплаты или присылайте запрос EcoCash прямо на телефон.

### Лицензирование встроено

Подписанные права, лицензионные ключи по почте, активация устройств и восстановление. Приложение проверяет всё офлайн.

### Подписки и рассрочка

Регулярные тарифы, «заплатить позже» по карте и понятный срок просрочки до окончания доступа.

### Возвраты и отмены

Полные и частичные возвраты через провайдера с записью о том, кто и почему их сделал.

### Настоящая тестовая среда

Тестовый ключ рядом с боевым, симулятор и перемотка времени, чтобы увидеть продление.

### Создано для агентов

skill.md, OpenAPI, MCP-сервер и инструменты WebMCP: ИИ может настроить оплату за вас.

Как это работает

## Три запроса от нуля до оплаты

1

### Регистрация

Один запрос возвращает боевой и тестовый ключи. Бесплатный тариф работает сразу.

2

### Продажа

Создайте платёж и получите ссылку на страницу оплаты или отправьте запрос в кошелёк на телефон.

3

### Расчёт

Подписанный вебхук или опрос подтверждает поступление. Лицензионный ключ отправляется автоматически.

Разработчикам

## Начните с curl. Закончите лицензионным ключом.

Каждый пример в документации сначала запускается в песочнице с тестовым ключом, так что можно безопасно экспериментировать.

[Открыть справочник API](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)

curl MCP JavaScript

```
# 1. register: a live key and a test key, shown once 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/register \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My App","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'

# 2. sell: returns a hosted checkout URL 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_test_… ' \
  -H 'idempotency-key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"my-app","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

```
# any MCP client: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/mcp 
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "wavepay_checkout",
    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
                   "provider": "paynow", "email": "buyer@example.com" } } }

# tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing,
#        wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_subscribe … 
```

```
const res = await fetch("https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "x-wavepay-service-key": process.env.WAVEPAY_KEY,
    "idempotency-key": crypto.randomUUID(),
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ productId: "my-app", planId: "pro",
                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
});
const { checkoutUrl, reference } = await res.json();
```

Вопросы

## Ответы, пока вы не спросили

Какие способы оплаты я могу принимать?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through Paynow; Visa, Mastercard and PayPal; and crypto on eleven rails (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron, USDT, USDC). 2Checkout is built and switches on when the provider approves our account.

Вы берёте процент с моих продаж?

Only after your plan's included payments, and the percentage falls as your volume grows (from 2% down to 0.4%, with a small minimum per payment). Provider fees are paid to the provider at cost with no WavePay markup.

Можно ли тестировать без реальных денег?

Да. При регистрации вы получаете тестовый ключ, работающий через симулятор. Он никогда не обращается к провайдеру и не учитывается в тарифе.

Как покупатели получают лицензию?

Когда платёж проведён, WavePay отправляет лицензионный ключ по почте, а ваше приложение может проверить подписанное право офлайн.

Может ли ИИ-агент пользоваться WavePay?

Да. Укажите ему skill.md, документ OpenAPI или MCP-сервер. Агент может зарегистрироваться, назначить цены, принять оплату и сверить данные без браузера.

# Subscription payment API for SaaS: renewals, instalments…

> WavePay is a subscription payment API for SaaS: recurring billing on PayPal and stored instruments where the provider allows it, buy-now-pay-later instalments…

USE CASE

# Subscription payment API for SaaS: renewals, instalments, refunds and licences

WavePay is a subscription payment API for SaaS: recurring billing on PayPal and stored instruments where the provider allows it, buy-now-pay-later instalments, refunds, and signed licence keys that verify offline, behind the same checkout call.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## The flow

1. Recurring: subscriptions run on PayPal billing and on stored payment instruments; Paynow card tokenisation is pending Paynow's approval and is not offered yet.
2. Instalments: split a price into scheduled payments with the buy-now-pay-later flow.
3. Refunds: POST a refund; the provider's own refund is made and the ledger updated.
4. Licences: a paid checkout emails an Ed25519-signed licence your app verifies offline.

## Questions

## Can I run subscriptions in Zimbabwe?

Subscriptions run on the rails that support recurring charges. Paynow tokenisation, which would extend this to local cards, is requested from Paynow and not yet available.

## Do paid plans refuse buyers at a cap?

No. Paid WavePay plans never refuse a buyer: payments beyond the plan's allowance are charged by the usage schedule.

> How WavePay keeps API keys, provider credentials and buyer data safe: hashed and sealed secrets, no card numbers, signed webhooks, scoped keys, and how to report a…

TRUST

# How WavePay protects your keys, your buyers and your money

How WavePay keeps API keys, provider credentials and buyer data safe: hashed and sealed secrets, no card numbers, signed webhooks, scoped keys, and how to report a vulnerability.

Updated 2026-10-31 · TeraTech Solutions (Private) Limited

## The short version

### We never see a card number

Card entry happens on the provider's own hosted page (Paynow, PayPal, 2Checkout). WavePay does not receive, store or transmit card numbers, so a breach of WavePay cannot leak them.

### Secrets are shown once

Your API keys are shown to you once and kept only as one-way hashes. We cannot read them back, and neither can anyone who copies our database.

### Your provider keys are sealed

If you connect your own PayPal account, its credentials are checked with PayPal and then encrypted at rest with AES-GCM under a key kept separate from the data. They are never logged and never returned by any route.

### Your money goes to you

With your own provider account connected, the provider pays you directly and WavePay never holds your funds.

## Keys and access

- **Scoped keys.** A merchant key can touch only that merchant's own sites, plans and payments. A test key settles with fake money and cannot connect a real provider account.
- **Revocable.** A key can be revoked at any time; a revoked key stops working at once.
- **Environment separation.** A live deployment refuses sandbox provider credentials and the reverse, so a test key can never be mistaken for a live account.
- **Constant-time checks.** Secrets are compared in constant time, and operator credentials are separate from merchant credentials.

## Payments are checked, not trusted

- **Verified with the provider.** A payment is settled only after WavePay has read it from the provider and the amount, currency, reference and plan match what was asked for.
- **No double settlement.** Each provider event or transaction can settle a payment once; a replay is refused. Checkouts take an Idempotency-Key, so a retry returns the same checkout and never charges twice.
- **Signed webhooks.** Settlement webhooks carry an HMAC signature you verify with your own secret. Licences are signed with Ed25519 and your software verifies them offline.
- **A failure never pays the wrong person.** If a connected account's credentials stop working, the payment is refused. It is never redirected to another account.

## Data we hold and how

- Buyer email addresses and phone numbers are encrypted at rest and also kept as keyed hashes for lookups, so an address can be matched without being stored in the clear.
- Traffic is encrypted in transit (TLS) and the service runs on Cloudflare's network with its database in the same platform.
- Requests are rate limited per client to blunt abuse, and routes that take no secret are limited in what they reveal.
- We keep what the service needs to settle, reconcile and support payments, and what the law requires us to keep as financial records. See the [privacy policy](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/privacy.html).

## What we ask of you

- Keep your live key out of client-side code and source control; use the test key while building.
- Verify the webhook signature on every delivery, and treat a status read from our API, not a redirect, as the truth about a payment.
- Connect your own provider account with its own limited credentials where the provider offers them, and tell us if a key may have leaked so we can revoke it.

## Report a vulnerability

Email [security@t3ratech.co.zw](mailto:security@t3ratech.co.zw). Our [security.txt](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/.well-known/security.txt) has the details. Please report privately, give us a reasonable time to fix before you publish, and do not access other people's data or disrupt the service. We acknowledge reports promptly, keep you informed, and credit researchers who want credit.

We do not publish internal architecture, limits or hostnames: that detail helps attackers and does not help you decide whether to trust us. If you need more for a security review, [ask us](mailto:support@t3ratech.co.zw) and we will answer under confidentiality.

## If something goes wrong

If we find that merchant or buyer data was exposed, we tell affected merchants without undue delay, say what happened and what to do, and fix the cause. Subscribers to [status](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/status.html) see service incidents as they happen.

  "params": {

    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
                   "provider": "paynow", "email": "buyer@example.com" } } }

# tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing,
#        wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_subscribe … 
```

```
const res = await fetch("https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "x-wavepay-service-key": process.env.WAVEPAY_KEY,
    "idempotency-key": crypto.randomUUID(),
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ productId: "my-app", planId: "pro",
                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
});
const { checkoutUrl, reference } = await res.json();
```

Mibvunzo

## Mhinduro usati wabvunza

Ndinogona kutambira nzira dzekubhadhara dzipi?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through Paynow; Visa, Mastercard and PayPal; and crypto on eleven rails (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron, USDT, USDC). 2Checkout is built and switches on when the provider approves our account.

Munotora muhuwandu hwekutengesa kwangu here?

Only after your plan's included payments, and the percentage falls as your volume grows (from 2% down to 0.4%, with a small minimum per payment). Provider fees are paid to the provider at cost with no WavePay markup.

Ndinogona kuyedza ndisina mari chaiyo here?

Hongu. Kunyoresa kunokupa kiyi yekuyedza inoshandisa simulator. Haimborasa kumupi wesevhisi uye haiverengwi muhurongwa hwako.

Vatengi vanowana sei rayisensi yavo?

Mubhadharo kana wapera, WavePay inotumira kiyi yerayisensi neemail, uye app yako inogona kusimbisa kodzero yakasainwa isina internet.

Ejenti yeAI inogona kushandisa WavePay here?

Hongu. Iratidze skill.md, gwaro reOpenAPI kana sevha yeMCP. Ejenti inogona kunyoresa, kuisa mitengo, kubhadharisa nekuenzanisa isina browser.

# WavePay — malipo na leseni kwa programu

> Pokea EcoCash, kadi na PayPal kwa API moja. Jisajili kwa ombi moja, jaribu kwa pesa bandia, kisha anza kutumia leseni, usajili na marejesho.

Now with crypto, subscriptions and your own PayPal account

# Lipwa kwa programu yako kupitia *kila njia ambayo wateja wako wanatumia*

API moja kwa EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, ZimSwitch, kadi na PayPal. Jisajili kwa ombi moja, jaribu kwa pesa bandia, kisha anza na leseni, usajili na marejesho vilivyojengwa ndani.

[Anza bila malipo](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.html#register) [Soma nyaraka](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html) [Kwa mawakala](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/skill.md)

- Mpango bure, bila kadi
- A fee that falls as you grow
- REST na MCP

## Kila njia ambayo mnunuzi anaweza kuwa nayo

Zimbabwean wallets, cards, PayPal and eleven crypto rails. The providers endpoint always says what is live today.

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal Bitcoin Ethereum Solana BNB Litecoin Dogecoin Tron USDT USDC 2Checkout · inakuja

Unachopata

## Malipo ni sehemu rahisi. WavePay ni yote yaliyobaki.

### Malipo ya ukurasa na ombi la pochi

Wapeleke wanunuzi kwenye ukurasa wa malipo, au tuma ombi la EcoCash moja kwa moja kwenye simu yao.

### Leseni zimejengwa ndani

Haki zilizotiwa saini, funguo za leseni kwa barua pepe, uwezeshaji wa vifaa na urejeshaji. Programu yako inathibitisha bila mtandao.

### Usajili na malipo ya awamu

Mipango ya kujirudia, nunua sasa lipa baadaye kwa kadi, na muda wazi wa kuchelewa kabla ya ufikiaji kuisha.

### Marejesho na ubatilishaji

Marejesho kamili na sehemu kupitia mtoa huduma, pamoja na kumbukumbu ya nani alifanya na kwa nini.

### Mazingira halisi ya majaribio

Ufunguo wa majaribio kando ya ufunguo wako halisi, kiigaji, na kusafiri wakati kuona upyaishaji ukitokea.

### Imejengwa kwa mawakala

skill.md, OpenAPI, seva ya MCP na zana za WebMCP, ili AI iweze kuweka malipo kwa ajili yako.

Jinsi inavyofanya kazi

## Maombi matatu kutoka sifuri hadi kulipwa

1

### Jisajili

Ombi moja linarudisha ufunguo halisi na wa majaribio. Mpango bure, unafanya kazi mara moja.

2

### Uza

Unda malipo upate kiungo cha ukurasa, au tuma ombi la pochi kwenye simu.

3

### Kamilisha

Webhook iliyotiwa saini au uchunguzi unathibitisha pesa. Ufunguo wa leseni hutumwa kiotomatiki.

Kwa wasanidi

## Anza na curl. Malizia na ufunguo wa leseni.

Kila mfano katika nyaraka unaendeshwa kwanza kwenye mazingira ya majaribio na ufunguo wa majaribio, ili uweze kukosea salama.

[Fungua marejeo ya API](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/docs.html)

curl MCP JavaScript

```
# 1. register: a live key and a test key, shown once 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/register \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"My App","ownerEmail":"you@example.com"}'

# 2. sell: returns a hosted checkout URL 
curl -sX POST https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts \
  -H 'x-wavepay-service-key: mk_test_… ' \
  -H 'idempotency-key: order-1001' \
  -d '{"productId":"my-app","planId":"pro","provider":"paynow","email":"buyer@example.com"}'
```

```
# any MCP client: https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/mcp 
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "wavepay_checkout",
    "arguments": { "productId": "my-app", "planId": "pro",
                   "provider": "paynow", "email": "buyer@example.com" } } }

# tools: wavepay_register, wavepay_providers, wavepay_pricing,
#        wavepay_checkout, wavepay_checkout_status, wavepay_subscribe … 
```

```
const res = await fetch("https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/v2/checkouts", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "x-wavepay-service-key": process.env.WAVEPAY_KEY,
    "idempotency-key": crypto.randomUUID(),
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ productId: "my-app", planId: "pro",
                         provider: "paypal", email: "buyer@example.com" }),
});
const { checkoutUrl, reference } = await res.json();
```

## Majibu kabla hujauliza

Ninaweza kupokea njia gani za malipo?

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through Paynow; Visa, Mastercard and PayPal; and crypto on eleven rails (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron, USDT, USDC). 2Checkout is built and switches on when the provider approves our account.

Mnachukua asilimia ya mauzo yangu?

Only after your plan's included payments, and the percentage falls as your volume grows (from 2% down to 0.4%, with a small minimum per payment). Provider fees are paid to the provider at cost with no WavePay markup.

Naweza kujaribu bila pesa halisi?

Ndiyo. Usajili hukupa ufunguo wa majaribio unaotumia kiigaji. Haufiki kwa mtoa huduma wala haujumuishwi kwenye mpango wako.

Wanunuzi wanapataje leseni yao?

Malipo yakikamilika, WavePay hutuma ufunguo wa leseni kwa barua pepe, na programu yako inaweza kuthibitisha haki iliyotiwa saini bila mtandao.

Wakala wa AI anaweza kutumia WavePay?

Ndiyo. Mwelekeze kwenye skill.md, hati ya OpenAPI au seva ya MCP. Wakala anaweza kujisajili, kupanga bei, kupokea malipo na kulinganisha bila kivinjari.

> The terms for using WavePay: the service, accounts and keys, fees and taxes, acceptable use, refunds and chargebacks, availability, liability and governing law.

LEGAL

# Terms of service

The terms for using WavePay: the service, accounts and keys, fees and taxes, acceptable use, refunds and chargebacks, availability, liability and governing law.

Updated 2026-10-31 · TeraTech Solutions (Private) Limited

## 1. The service

WavePay provides checkout, licensing and a payments ledger over third-party payment providers. We are not a bank, we do not lend, and (unless a page says otherwise) we do not hold your funds: the provider you connect pays you. We are not the merchant of record.

## 2. Your account and keys

You are responsible for your keys and for what is done with them. Keep them secret, revoke any that may have leaked, and tell us promptly. You must give accurate details and have the right to use the provider accounts you connect.

## 3. Fees and taxes

Fees are the plan and usage fees on the [pricing page](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.html) (also at [pricing.json](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/pricing.json)), exclusive of VAT where it applies, billed monthly in arrears. Provider fees, bank charges and transfer taxes are paid by you to the provider at cost; we add no markup. We may change prices on notice; a change does not affect a month already billed.

## 4. Acceptable use

Do not use WavePay for anything illegal, for goods or services the providers prohibit, to test stolen payment instruments, to evade provider rules, to attack or overload the service, or to access data that is not yours.

## 5. Refunds, disputes and chargebacks

Refunds go through the provider. Disputes and chargebacks are between you, the buyer and the provider, and the liability for them is yours. We help with records.

## 6. Providers and crypto

Each provider's own terms apply to its rails and may limit what it will process or where it operates. Crypto payments to T3raTech's own sales are irreversible once confirmed and are settled when the exchange credits the exact amount quoted.

## 7. Availability

We aim for a reliable service and publish [status](https://wavepay.t3ratech.co.zw/status.html), but unless an Enterprise agreement says otherwise we do not promise uninterrupted service. Providers can fail independently of us.

## 8. Liability

To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, and our total liability for a claim is limited to the fees you paid us in the three months before it arose. Nothing limits liability that cannot be limited by law.

## 9. Ending

You may stop at any time and disconnect your accounts. We may suspend a merchant who breaks these terms or the providers' rules, or whose use creates risk, and will say why where we can.

## 10. Law and changes

These terms are governed by the laws of Zimbabwe and disputes go to its courts, without limiting rights you have as a consumer elsewhere. We will post changes with a new date.

# WavePay — 软件的支付与许可证服务

> 用一个 API 接收 EcoCash、银行卡和 PayPal。一次请求完成注册，用模拟资金测试，再上线并使用许可证、订阅和退款功能。

Now with crypto, subscriptions and your own PayPal account

# 让你的软件收款覆盖 *买家手里的每一种支付方式*

一个 API 对接 EcoCash、OneMoney、InnBucks、ZimSwitch、银行卡和 PayPal。一次请求注册，用模拟资金测试，上线后内置许可证、订阅和退款。

支付渠道

## 买家可能持有的每一种渠道

Zimbabwean wallets, cards, PayPal and eleven crypto rails. The providers endpoint always says what is live today.

EcoCash OneMoney InnBucks Telecash O'mari ZimSwitch Visa Mastercard PayPal Bitcoin Ethereum Solana BNB Litecoin Dogecoin Tron USDT USDC 2Checkout · 即将推出

你将获得

## 结账只是简单的部分，其余都交给 WavePay。

### 托管结账与钱包推送

把买家引导到托管页面，或直接向其手机推送 EcoCash 请求。

### 内置许可证管理

签名授权、邮件发送许可证密钥、设备激活与找回。你的应用可离线验证。

### 订阅与分期

周期性方案、银行卡先买后付，以及访问权限结束前清晰的宽限期。

### 退款与冲正

通过支付提供商进行全额或部分退款，并记录操作人和原因。

### 真正的测试环境

在正式密钥旁提供测试密钥、模拟器，以及可快进时间观察续订的功能。

### 为智能体而建

skill.md、OpenAPI、MCP 服务器和 WebMCP 工具，让 AI 替你配置结账。

工作方式

## 从零到收款只需三次请求

1

### 注册

一次请求返回正式密钥和测试密钥。免费方案，立即可用。

2

### 销售

创建结账并获得托管链接，或向手机推送钱包请求。

3

### 结算

签名的 Webhook 或轮询确认到账，许可证密钥自动通过邮件发出。

问答

## 在你提问之前先给出答案

我可以接受哪些支付方式？

EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through Paynow; Visa, Mastercard and PayPal; and crypto on eleven rails (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron, USDT, USDC). 2Checkout is built and switches on when the provider approves our account.

你们会抽取我销售额的百分比吗？

Only after your plan's included payments, and the percentage falls as your volume grows (from 2% down to 0.4%, with a small minimum per payment). Provider fees are paid to the provider at cost with no WavePay markup.

可以不用真钱进行测试吗？

可以。注册后你会得到使用模拟器的测试密钥，它不会触达任何提供商，也不计入你的方案额度。

买家如何获得许可证？

付款结算后，WavePay 会通过邮件发送许可证密钥，你的应用可离线验证签名授权。

AI 智能体可以使用 WavePay 吗？

可以。让它读取 skill.md、OpenAPI 文档或 MCP 服务器即可。智能体无需浏览器就能完成注册、定价、结账和对账。

# Zimbabwe payment gateway API: EcoCash, OneMoney, Visa and…

> WavePay is a Zimbabwe payment gateway API: one POST /v2/checkouts reaches EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through Paynow, plus Visa…

USE CASE

# Zimbabwe payment gateway API: EcoCash, OneMoney, Visa and Mastercard in one integration

WavePay is a Zimbabwe payment gateway API: one POST /v2/checkouts reaches EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari and ZimSwitch through Paynow, plus Visa, Mastercard and PayPal for international buyers, with signed settlement webhooks and one payments ledger.

Updated 2026-10-30 · by T3raTech · Free: 25 payments per 30 days, $0; Starter: 100 payments per 30 days for $15/month; Growth (recommended): 500 payments per 30 days for $49/month; Scale: 2,500 payments per 30 days for $149/month; Enterprise: custom volume from $499/month

## The flow

1. EcoCash payment API: provider paynow-mobile with the buyer's phone number pushes the EcoCash prompt to their handset; OneMoney, InnBucks and O'mari work the same way.
2. Cards and ZimSwitch: the hosted Paynow page takes Visa, Mastercard and ZimSwitch; international buyers can pay with PayPal.
3. Settle: a signed webhook, or poll GET /v2/checkouts/<reference>/status until collected.
4. Costs: a WavePay plan plus a small percentage that falls with volume (see /pricing.html); provider fees are paid to the provider at cost with no WavePay markup.

## Questions

## Is there an EcoCash payment API?

Yes. Through Paynow, provider paynow-mobile sends the EcoCash prompt to the buyer's phone; the same call covers OneMoney, InnBucks and O'mari.

## Which currency does it settle in?

Paynow checkouts are priced in US dollars. Which rails a deployment offers is reported live by GET /v2/providers.
